Motokari nhema yakamira. Kurudyi kwayo kune murume akagumbata maoko akaisa minwe yake pamuromo. Kuruboshwe rwake kune vanhu vagara pasi vamwe vakamira. Kumusana kwake kune chitoro chakavhurwa mukova chine magasi tengi pamberi pacho pane maSolar panel maviri.
Ruva rinamashizha akawanda akasvibira egirini pamwe nemashoma ane ruvara rweyero.
Muti wemupopo wakabereka michero yakawanda. Pedyo nemuti uyu kune mimwe miti isiri yemipopo. Pasi pemuti uyu panoratidza kuti pane uswa.

Musoro wemunhukadzi wakarukwa.Wakarukwa madhiredzi erudzi rwakatsvukirira.Unorukwa uchitanga kubva kumashure zvichiuya kumberi.Zvasvika kumberi madhiredzi anoremberera achiuya kuuso.Izvi zvakarukwa zvakanaka chose.
Pamberi pezvimwe zvitoro pane mazitombo. Zvitoro izvi zvinoita sezvakavharwa uyezve zvakavakwa nezvidhinha zvikapfirirwa nemarata. Pamberi pezvitoro izvi zvakare pane marara.

Motokari zhinji dzakasiyana - siyana dziri kufamba mumugwagwa. Parutivi pane chivakwa chesimbi namarata chekugarira vanhu vakamirira motokari dzekukwira. Rumwe rutivi kune miti dzakareba dzina maruva aneruvara rwepepuru.

Michero yakarongedzwa kuti itengeswe. Yakawanda uye yakaiswa muzvima bokisi zvine simbi mukati uyewo imwe yacho yakaiswa pamusoro pezvima kadhibhokisi. Inosanganisira mabanana pouyawo maranjisi aripo nemaapuru. Panewo zvakare zvimachipisi zvemhando dzakasiyana zviripo kuti vanhu vagotenga.
Mumugwagwa une tara, uine marara pasi vanhu vachifamba, motokari yakamira panodirwa mafuta emotokari.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti izhira inofamba neveruzhinji, vaye vanofamba netsoka. Parutivi pezhira iyi pane chishendi chakagadzirwa nematanda chikavharwa nemapepa. Mukati macho mune zvinhu zvakasiyana zvoratidza kuti zvirikutengeswa.
Mumugwagwa unoita seuri pakati pedhorobha mune motokari dziri kuzvifambira dzakawanda. Nechekurutivi kwemugwagwa uyu kunewo vanhu vari kuzvifambira uye mumwe murume akagara pasi.

Makwayi ari musango arikufura akawanda uyezve mamwe ane ruvara ruchena mamwe ane ruvara rwebhurwuni rwakasangana neruchena. Pane zvimuswe zvakakora zviri kuoneka uye kuseri kwawo kune mahuswa neminzwa iriko. Nechokumberi kune gomo riri kuoneka.
Munhu arikufamba munotengeswa mbatatisi mumusika. Uye mumwe kapfeka zvichena ne nguwane yebhurawuni arikutenga mambatatisi.
Nhandare inotambirwa mitambo yakasiyana inosanganisira kiriketi kana nhabvu. Nhandare iyi ineuswa hwakawanda hupfupi hune ruvara rwegirini.

Zvinhu zvinoiswa mumba yekutandarira zvakarongedzwa kuti zvitengeswe. Zvakanaka zvikuru uye zvakangoiswa mazitanda akati mbikiti. Pokugara ndopazoiswa utefetefe usina kunyanya kukura. Zvakarewo mhando iyi haina kunyanya kunonekwa munyika saka ndomanakiro azvakaita.
Pane gungano rakawanda pane madzimai aripo, madzimai aya akasunga madhuku mumusoro uye mamwe evadzimai aya akasunga mazambia muchiuno. vadzimai varipo vanoratidza kuti vakatarisa pasi.

Mugwagwa miviri ine tara iri  mhiri nemhiri.  Kune mumwe wacho muri kutofamba motokari. Mberi kuri kuratidza miti mikuru yemiJacaranda ine maruva akaita pepuru.  Pasi  pemiti iyi  pane sora rakaoma  rinoratidza kuti rava nenguva risina kumbowana mwando kana kunaiwa nemvura.
Mafaira eruvara rwakasiyana runoti bhuruu, girinhi nepingi. Anoshandiswa pakuchengeta mapepa akakosha anoita kuti zvinhu zvichengetedzeke.
Kune bveni rakagara pakati pematombo. Gudo iri rakagara rakabata makumbo aro. Gudo iri rinemasizo matsvuku.

Mugwagwa unofamba dzi motokari uyo une ivhu pamwechete netumweo tumatombo tudiki. Nechepadivi pomugwagwa uyu pane chi bhodhi chiripo chakanyorwao ne ruwara rutema nezvimweo zvine rúchena. Zvakare pane zvimwe zvinhu zvakadhirowewao.

Mugwagwa uri kufambawo motokari dzakasiyana siyana dzinosanganisira mabhazi nezvimwewo zvichienda kunzvimbo dzakasiyana. Mugwagwa uyu unewo mitaro ine mavara akasiyana siyana inewo zvainoratidzira pamwe chete nekureva.
Murume ari kumba muguta.Akabata bepa re yero ne bhegi kumusana.Kumberi kwake kune motokari dzakamira padivi pechivakwa.

Chikafu chekudya chakaiswa zvakanaka mundiro. Pane pamwe pane mupunga koita pamwe panenyama yenguruve, pozoitazve miriwo yakasanganaine bhinzi nemakerotsi. Chikafu ichi chakanaka uye chinovaka muviri nekuti zvizhinji zvinodiwa nemuviri munhu anozviwana paanenge achidya.
Pedyo nemumugwagwa nechekurutivi kwawo kune imba yemudurikidzanwa. Kozotiwo mumugwagwa iwowo munemotokari nhema yakamira yakabatidza mwenje.
Mhuka ine ruvara rwebhuruu pamusoro pakaita pepfumbu. Inowanikwa mugungwa. Inonzi shumba yemugungwa kana kuti "sea lion". Mhuka iyi inoratidza kutyisa.
Guta guru rinedzimba dzakaturikidzana nezvitoro zvine zvitinha zvakavakwa neruvara rutsvuku, riripedo nemugwagwa unemotikari.
Wadhiropu ine ruvara rwegireyi.Ine mikova inemibato yesimbi uye iri ye bhureki yakagara pauriri rwakasvibira.Uye rumwe rupande gwune zvekuzvuva negirazi rekuzviona.
Mhando yechirimwa chinonzi chibage.  Ichi china mavara machena, yero nepepuru.  Chakafururwa chikaunganidzwa kuita dutu.

Ngarikuni guru, gonho rakavhura maparipo ayo richiratidza kuti riri kuzvitutumadza zvaro, rakavhura nebesu kuita seshiri iya inonzi Pikoki.  Musoro waro une ruvara ruchena,  muhuro makatsvuka kuti piroo.

Nzvimbo yakapfumba inoratidza kuti inofamba veruzhinji. Nechemujinga menzvimbo iyi munemudhuri yakavakwa isina kuzopendwa asi yakapurasitwa. Yose yakapfurirwa nemazen'e uye inoratidza kuti yava nenguva yavakwa sezvo yavakusakara.
Ngetani dzemuhuro dzinoratidza chanza chemunhu.
Ruva rakasimudzwa , rakanyatsokusvibira, rinoratidza kuti ririkutengeswa sezvo rakaiswa muchipepa. Ruva iri rinoratidza kuti rinowana mwando wakakwana uye rine mufudze wakakwana.
Pane ndiro nhema ine kudya kwemandorokwati. Kudya uku kunosanganisira mbatatisi dzakabikwa zvakanaka dzikaiswa madomasi akachekererwa asina kubikwa pamusoro.
Gonzo riri kuonekwa rakafa  rine ruvara nemambava ebhurawuni nemuromo muchena. Padivi pari kuonekwa zvigaba zvakavhurika zvine ruvara rutema nemushonga wokuuraya makonzo uri mugaba reruvara ruchena.

Vanhu vari kuita zvakasiyana varume nevakadzi. Vamwe ndovarikufamba vamwe vakamira. Vamwe vakagara pazvituro vakawaridza zvinhu parutivi zviri kuratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa. Nechekumberi kuri kubuda mugwagwa uri kufamba motokari dzemhando dzakasiyana.

Munhukadzi akagara akatarisa zvinhu zvake zvaakarongedza kuti atengese. Akagara pakabhenji kezvitanda uyewo akatambanudza ruoko akaisa kuzvinhu zvaari kutengesa zvinosanganisa mafuta okubukisa uyewo mikaka inoiswa muputugadzike.
Danga rimwechete rakakura rakagadzirwa nemapuranga,waya pamwe namarata. Kuseri kune bango rakagadzirwa nesimende rinotakura waya dzinofambisa mwando wamagetsi.
Padivi pomugwagwa pane zvitoro zvikuru zvine mipanda yenhurikidzwa nemotokari dzakamira chena netema, zvitoro zvakaratidzwa namazita azvo uye mugwagwa une tara.
Mudzimai akapfeka sikipa tsvuku nechikabudura chitema ari kutora wadhirobhu iri panze mufananidzo. Wadhirobhu iyi ine mufananidzo wegireyi uye ine mibato pamagonhi ayo ine ruvara rwesirivheri.
Zvitoro zviri kutengesa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana. Pane chimwe pari kutengeswa hembe. Pane hembe dzakaiswa muzvidhori, chikipa chitsvuku nechitirauzi chitema. Pane imwe pari kutengeswa zvemafoni.

Michero yakarongedzwa zvakanaka zvikuru yakadurikidzana. Iri kuda kuti vanhu vaone vagotenga. Uye ine ruvara rweyero rwakanaka zvikuru. Yakangosangana yakadaro inoyevedza kutarisa. Zvakarevo ikadyiwa inoita kuti miviri isimbe.
Uyo unoratidza kuti muriwo une dovi. Mune muriwo,madomasi nehanyanisi
Nzvimbo irikuratidza kuti mudhorobha netara negaraji rekumwira peturo kana dhiziri uye nemotokari nevanhu varikufamba netsoka varikuratidza kuti vamwe vacho vanotengesa.
Pane chibhorani chiripakati pedzimba dzirikuvakwa. Dzimba idzi dzirikuvakwa nezvitina uye hadzisati dzapera. Kozotiwo nechepedyo pedzimba idzi, pane mugwagwa urikupfuura nepo.

Maruva akamira akadyarwa zvakanaka aneruvara rwegirinhi, uyewo unezvivana zvainazvo zvimwe zvakaita sezvimbora.Anoyevedza kutarisa mumazizo. Uyewo maruva anogona kutanhwa achiiswa kana mudzichechi, uyewo mumba.

Mugwagwa une Tara,mujinga mawo, mune mota dzakamiswa dziri kuita majana kutaukura veruzhinji dzichiita zvemushika shika, parutivi rwemota iyi pane bhazi gur rine ruvara rweYero inoratidza kuti riri kutakura vanhu servo rakavhurwa kuBhuti kwaro riri kurongedzerwa zvinhu.

Munhandare munoitirwa mutambo wekiriketi. Zvikwata zviviri zviri kutatsurana. Vamwe vakapfeka yunifomu yeyero vamwe ndivo vakapfeka matisheti ane manyerekete egirini nemitodo mitema. Kumacheto  kwenhandare kune zvikwangwani zvinoshambadza.
Michero  yechiringu  iri yerudzi rwama strawberry yakagadzikwa mundiro iri mutsvuku.

Nzvimbo inorasirwa zvinhu nevanhu vemunharaunda.  Ine zvinhu zvakamwararika pasi.  Uyewo pane pamwe parikuoneka tsito nemadota. Kuratidza kuti pane zvakapisiwa. Izvi zvakatoita kuti masora akakomberedza atsvewo zvekare. Uyewo pane mapepa akasara  asina kutsva arikuoneka ari pasi.

Nzvimbo ine pasi pakatsemuka tsemuka pari kufamba vanhu vakawanda vangopesana vachienda mativi akasiyana. Pane motokari iripo. Pasi pemuti  pane murume akagara akazembera muti une mashizha egirinhi madiki nemumwe akamira. Pane chivakwa chine ruvara rwekirimu chine chibhakani chichena pamberi  chinoratidza kuti chitoro. Pamberi pechitoro pane vanhu vari kufamba famba.
Muti une mashizha madiki eruvara rwebumhudza uye matanda akaoma eruvara rwepfumbu akapindana pindana achivharidzira kuti mutariri arege kuona zviriseri.
Vanhu vakaungana pamusoro peguva rakavakwa nedombo dema uye pane madzimai akapfeka mabhachi matsvuku nengowanai chena nemasiketi matema neshangu tema.

Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara. Kurudyi rwemugwagwa uyu kune nzvimbo ine maruva nemiti yakawanda. Miti iyi nemaruva aya zvine ruvara rwegirinhi noruvara rutsvuku. Nzvimbo iyi ine zvikwangwane zvakanyorwa zvine ruvara ruchena nerutema.
Bhazi rezupco rine ruvara rwegirini nemutsetse weyero nechepakati
Mureza une ruvara rwebhuruu kumusoro uye ruvara rweyero kuzasi. Pakati pemureza uyu pane nyeredzi iripo ine ruvara rwutema.

Bhokisi guru rino shandisirwa kuchengetera hembe nevazhinji rakagadzirwa zvine unyanzvi rinozivikanwa nokuti hodhiropu. Rine mikova mitatu, miviri iri kumativi nemumwe uripakati une girazi rekuzviona kana uchisimira kana kuti uchipfeka.
Vatambi venhabvu varimubishi kutamba nhabvu, vanoratidza kuti vane shungu dzekuda kukunda. Munhandare mune vanhu vashoma vari kuona nhabvu, pasi penhandare pane huswa hwakachekerwa zvakanaka.
Apa pane chihedhibhodhi chinoiswa kumusoro  kwomubhedha. Uye nechikabhodhi chaunogona kugarira kana kuisa zvinhu mukati. Zvine ruvara rwegireyi, zvakagadzikwa pauswa hwegirini pedo nechidziro.
Danda remagetsi rine tambo ina dzinoenda dzichifuura nepamusoro pemudhuri wejuraworo wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvihombe.
Uswa unoratidza kuti wakasakurwa  uchiri hudiki we girinhi.  Parutivi pacho pane tumiti tudiki.  Sezvo inoitawo kuti nzvimbo inge  ichiratidzika uye panonayawo mvura nzvimbo isakukurwa.

Imba yakavakwa zvinomwisa mvura. Yakaiswa denga rehuswa pamusoro uyewo rakagadzirwa zvakanaka kwazvo yoita pekuti vanhu vanogara pasi vachitandara. Pamukova pane maruva maviri mamwe ari kurudyi mamwe arikuruboshwe.
Imba yakavakwa iri munharaunda inogara veruzhinji paine mumwe mudhuri wakavakwa usina kupera iine dhishi riripo panze nemacheya maviri.

Musikana akaurukwa mitsara inobva kuhuma zvichienda pamausoro. Zvozosungwa pamasoro ipapo zvimwe zvodzika pasi zvichiratidza kunaka zvikuru. Wozoiswa zvimwe zvine ruvara rwebhuru kuti zvinyatsooneka zvakanaka.
Murume akamira akasimudza maoko ake ese mudenga uye akasimudzawo  musoro  akatarisa mudenga zvakare akapfeka heti mumusoro, akapfeka sikipa isina maoko yatingati ivesi.

Zvikwenzi zviripanzvimbo yakaita kakukwirira zvikwenzi izvi panezvimwe zvinemavara egirini akasvibira poitawo zvimwe zvineruvara rwakaita kakutsvukuruka. Panematombo aripo uyewo nemiti imwe yakangosangana. Nzvimbo dzakadai vanhu vanofarira kuendapo vachinonamata havo vari vega.
Kudya, kwakaiswa mundiro chena.idzi ndiro dzakagadzikwa patafura.kudya uku kwakasiyana siyana,pane nyama,pane mupunga, pane makeroti,pane machipisi nezvimwewo.
Muti wakamoneredzwa nemidzi yemumwe muti nezvimakwenzi zvipfupi zvine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini nechivakwa chinoratidza kuti chidzidziro chevana vechikoro.
Muti wemuchero wemumango unemashizha mahombe ane ruvara rwegirinhi. Pane mibhinana inenge  iri padyo nemumango uyu. Unoratidza kuti unamaruva okubereka ari kutanga.

Badza rinova rimwe remidziyo yakakosha inoshandiswawo pamba.Rinonyanya kushanda munguva dzekurima.Rinoitawo basa rekuchera makomba kana vanhu vachidyara,kusakura, kugadzira mihomba yembambayira kana murivo uye zvimwewo.
Vanhu vechidzimai varikumhanya munhandare. Ari kwekutanga akapfeka hembe tema nemudhebhe wegirinhi une mitsetse yewaiti mumwe wachonq akapfeka nguwani tema

Mukati mwemumwe musika,  murikutengeswa mbatatisi. Mumusika umu pane ngoro iripedyo  naamai vakagara pane chimwe chigaro. Amai ava vakasunga dhuku. Nechepadivi pavo pane murume arikufamba akapfeka hovhorosi.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inorashirwa marara neveruzhinji sezvo pane marara akasiyana anosanganisira makadhibhokisi, mapepa nezvigubhi zvezvimwiwa zvakasiyana. Panzvimbo iyi pane sora rakaoma rinoratidza kuti ravane nguva risina kumbo naiwa nemvura.

Chitoro chinotengeserwa zvinhu chikuru chemuZimbabwe  chakakomberedzwa neruzhowa rwemasimbi.  Pamberi pacho pakanyorwa nezvitsvuku uye pane kanenge kamuti kegirini kari pedyo.  Masimbi ari  nechekumberi kwechitoro uyewo pane motikari dzakamira pamberi pechitoro dzakachiteedza.

Vanhu vazhinji vanosanganisira varume nevakadzi.  Vamwe vakamira vamwe vari kuratidzira kuti vari kufamba.  Vazhinji vavo vakapfeka magemenzi matema neheti tema mumusoro  dzefundo, zvichibva zvaita kuti  tifungire  kuti  vapedza   zvidzidzo zvavo  zvepamusoro zvingava zvekoreji kana zveyunivesiti.
Necheparutivi pemumwe mugwagwa pane muti uripo. Muti uyu uri pakati pemahuswa. Nechakati taramukei kwemuti uyu kune dzimba dziriko dzinoita sedziri pakati pekuvakwa.

Maruva akadzvarwa zvakanaka pachirokari. Akangosangana mamwe aneruvara rwegirini mamwewo akaita sezviuswa. Pakaiswawo zvakare chimufananidzo chechishiri chinenge dhadha chineruvara rwuchena. Poitawo chimwe chishiri chakareba chiri chimufananidzo zvakare.
Miti dzakawanda dzakareba dzinemashizha akawanda akasvibira neruvara rwegirini. Mimwe muti ine maruva aneruvara rwe pepuro.
Vanhu vakawanda madzimai nevarume vakagara pasi. Vakapfeka zvipfeko zvakasiyana. Miti yakasvibira chaizvo.
Misika ine vanhu vakawanda vari kutengesa. Umwe munhukadzi akagara pasi akapfeka ngowani tsvuku, hembe yebhuruu kumusoro, rusero, makadhibhokisi, bhaketi reyero.
Mumugwagwa wecheja, pane mumvuri webhazi riri kupfuramo. Pedyo nemumvuri uyu kune mwana anoita wechikoro akapfeka heti arikuzvifambira.
Zvuma zvakasiyana-siyana zvakaunganidzwa kuti vanhu vatenge. Zvineruvara rwakasiyana-siyana runosanganisira rwegoridhe rwebhuruu nedzimwe mhandoo dzemakara dzinosanganisira girini.
Ndiro yedanda yakapakurirwa nyama yakatsvukira zvikuru kwazvo. Nyama iyi inoratidza kuti mazondo enguruve anodaidzwa nechirungu kuti matirotasi. Pamusoro pawo pakamwaiwa mvere dzakabva pamuboora.

Nzvimbo yemuHarare ye konisitirakisheni hauzi. Pane mifananidzo yevanhu vamwe vari kupika pasi nevamwe vari kuita mabasa akasiyana-siyana.  Pane chikwangwari chekusheedzerawo nzvimboy yekuti vanhu vabhadhare kuti vashandise.

Muti muhombe une mashizha akasvibira wakamera pakati pemabwe mahombe muchikomo chine mabwe mazhinji. Pedyo nerimwe ibwe pane mutizve une mashizha mashoma akasvibira. Pakati pemabwe madoko pane huswawo hunyoro hwakasvibira.
Zvokudya zvaiswa patafura zvinoti keni rerata mune zvokunwa zvinotonhorera, parutivi pane chingwa chakaiswa nyama pamwe nembatatisi dzakakangwa uye nemuto wemadomasi.
Bhazi guru rekwa Chihwa rinonzi Chihwa 'Tours', rine ruvara ruchena , rutsvuku nemamwe ma bhokisi bhokisi ekuti rive rakanaka. Bhazi iri rine mafafitera matema uye akanaka zvikuru kwazvo.

Mashizha emuti wemubanana mazhinji acho akapfambanyuka kana ku tingati kutsemuka tsemuka icharatidza kuti anorohwa nemhepo yakanyanya.nechekumusoro kwacho tirikuona tambo refu inoratidza kuti itambo yemagetsi.

Nharaunda inogara vanhu ine tumba tupfupi. Tune matenga emaasibhesitasii pouya pamwe pane matombo pakavhurwa zvishoma nechepamberi. Kuno rumwe rutivi kune mazitombo ariko makuru kwoitawo miti yokupa mumvuri pane tumba tune matenga madiki.

Mudziyo unoshandiswa pamba. Une demo rimwe divi nepiki kune rimwe divi unonzi bhidha. Uri kuratidza kuti simbi iyi pane pairi kupiswa uyezve simbi inoratidza kuita simbi hombe yakasimba. Mudziyo uyu hauna kuiswa mupinyi . Uri pane ruvara rwegireyi.
Shumba nemwana wayo ari kumusana, yakavata pasi uye yakatarisa mberi. Kamwana kacho karikuoneka gumbo reruboshwe rakabatira pana mai vacho.
Vanhu vakamira mukati memba, vechidzimai ndivo vakamira kumberi uye vari vakawanda, kumashure kunoonekwawo munhu wemurume akapfeka hembe yeblue  akabata muchiwuno.
Sherefu yechizvino zvino inorongedzerwa ndiro mumba mekubikira yakaiswa mumba iri chena.Sherefu inoratidza kuti haina zvainazvo mairi. Uye ichiri itsva.Ine zvekukiyisa.
Mabhazi akamira rimwe pamberi rimwe mumashure nemasimbi akagadzirwa.
Fodya ine ruvara rwegirini. Shizha iri nechepakati rine ruvara rutema robva raita ruvara rweyero. Fodya yakakosha inorimwa munzvimbo dzakawanda dzakaita sana Chegutu nekumwewo kwakadero.
Munhurume ari kufamba akabereka bhegi rine ruvara rwebhuruu nebhurauni. Parutivi pane mwana musikana mudiki akamira.

Chimiro chemugwagwa wakagadzirwa ukaiswa tara. Unofamba motokari dzakasiyana siyana. Mumacheto memugwagwa uyu mune miti imwe yacho inosanganisira mijakaranda inoonekwa nemaruva ane ruvara rwepepuro. Kunozouyawo rusvingo rwakagadzirwa nesemende kumacheto.
Pedyo nemugwagwa pane zimuti ziguru rine mumvuri mudiki. Pedyo nezimuti iri pane gedhe resimbi. Nechekure kwemuti uyu kune imba yakavakwa  nezvitinha yakaiswa  mazenge pamusoro.
Uswa hwakawanda zvinotaridza kuti musango. Musango umu mune huswa hwakati kurei wakachenerukira kobva kwaita miti. Miti iyi iri kungoonekwa kuzasi kune ruvara rutema neruvara ruchana.

Vatungamiri vezvefundo vakagara panzvimbo pavarikuitira musangano. Vakapfeka mbatya dzakasiyana, vamwe vakapfeka masutu, vamwewo vakapfeka mbatya dzineruvara rwekaki. Pane umwe pakati pavo arikutaura panharunharembozha, poitawo vamwe vakagara vakabata mabhuku.

Shangu dzinopfekwa kurudyi nekuruboshwe. Dzine ruvara rwebhuruu uye dzine tutambo twakasungwa turi kuenda kumberi. Mukati madzo mutema uye kumativi kuchena. Kunze kwadzo dzine pamwe pane ruvara rwutema nerutsvuku. Dzakatetsvera zvishoma kumuromo. Imhando inopfekwa vanhu vachienda kunoita zvemutambo kana kumhanya. Dzakavharika muviri wese.

Imba yakavakwa zvakanaka. Imba huru uyewo yakaiswa zvidhinawo zvakavakisa. Zvidhina zvacho  hazvina kuiswa penda. Mumba mukati  pasi pane mataira emhando dzakasiyana. Pane mamwe anoita kutsvedzerera poita mamwe akagadzirwa nemapuranga aneruvara rwebhurawuni.

Mugwagwa mukuru une motokari dziri kufamba. Dzimwe dziri kupesana dzine ruvara ruchena. Yakaiswa tara. Pane nzira inofambwa navanhu. Zvinoratidza kuti yakapfumbira. Pane vanhu vari kufamba vari nechokumberimberi uye panoratida kuti pane panokwirirwa bhazi kana kuti panokwirirwa motokari, panogarwa navanhu pana matombo nechimuti chikuru. Nzira inofambwa navanhu iyi ine mapepa akawanda netsvina, ipo panotandarira vanhu apo vachimirira tiranisipoti.
Kudya kwakatsvetwa mundiro chena yedhaka kunosanganisira sadza jena nemuriwo wemuboora wakatsvetwa maonyeni nemadomasi.

Panodyira vana vadiki pakashongedzwa zvinonwisa mvura.Pane tafura yakaiswa mucheka muchena.Nendiro dzakaiswa zvekudyisa zvakaputirwa nemucheka.Zvigaro zviripo zvekugara ndezvamapurasitiki uye zvina mavara akasiyana.Pane makomichi ekunwira aripo patafura.Panoyevedza kutarisa.
Nzvimbo yemuguta inoonekwa sevhisi sitesheni yakanyorwa kuti Total. Nechekumashure kunoonekwa munhu wechidzimai akatakura saga pamusoro pake.

Tafura ichangobva kugadzirwa yakatotsvetwa pasi pavhu. Tafura iyi itafura dziya dzinoshandiswa mumahofisi  akasiyana-siyana. Tafura iyi iri kuratidza kuti yatozorwa mushonga  wokuti ihwinyirire pamusoro payo.
Vanhu vazhinji vari kufamba vamwe vakamira. Mukomana mumwechete akatakura zvidhori zvakakura zvitatu uye nebhegi. Pasi pane kamusika kari kutengeserwa zvekudya.

Mukomberedzo wemba wakagadzirwa nezvitinha uye nesemende. Padivi pemukomberedzo wemba uyu pane kanzira kanevhu kasina tara. Padivi pemugwagwa uyu usina tara pane miti iripo yakawanda. Imwe yakaoma imwe ine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini.
Maruva aneruvara rwakasiyana runoti girini nepingi ayo anoita zvekudzvarwa pamba kuitira kuti pamba pakanaka uye mweya wacho unge wakanaka watinofema sezvinokudzwa.

Zvigaro zvinoshandiswa pamutambo mizhinji pamagungano zvakaturikidzaniswa. Parikuonekwa zvigaro zvinofana kunge zviri zvitatu zvakatso kurongedzwa zvakaturikidzana. Mberi kwezvigaro izvi kuri kubudikirawo chigaro chesofa.
Murume ari kutaridza kuti ari mumhepo ari kujamba asina kupfeka hembe yekumusoro.Akagerwa mumusoro.Kuzasi akasimira bhurugwa rinoita kunge rakabayirwa minhenga yeshiri.

Vadzidzi vekuchikoro che Gireti Zimbabwe vakaungana munzvimbo.  Vakapfeka mbatya dzakanyorwa zita rechikoro chavo  uye vane nguwani dzeyero pamusoro.  Pane vamwewo vari pavari vakapfeka mbatya chena dzine zvebhuruu mumaoko.  Vanoratidza kuti vane zvemutambo zvavari kuita pamwechete imomo mavakaungana uye mune vanhu vari kutotamba mutambo wemadhatsi.  Saka ivo zvinoratidza kuti vauya kuzomiririra chikoro chavo.

Mugwagwa une tara, mujinga memugwagwa uyu mune miti mikuru. Mumwe wacho une mhango pahunde yawo. Pasi pemiti iyi pane marara akasiyana anosanganisira  zvipepa nezvigubhu nesora rakaoma,  zvinobva zvaita kuti tifunge kuti inguva yechirimo kana kuti nguva yechando.

Panzvimbo pane zvimera zvakawanda. Pane nzimbe dziripo dzakabukira. Pane miti zvakare ine mashizha ane ruvara rwakasvibira rwegirini. Zvinoratidza kuti panzvimbo apa pane mvura nekuti pane tepi dziripo uye tengi remvura riri pamusoro.
Badza rakasiiwa panzvimbo isina huswa. Badza iri rine simbi kumberi uye rakarodzwa kwarino chera nako. Rine mupinyi wakareba, mupinyi wacho wakagadzirwa nemuti.
Mudhuri mukuru kwazvo wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvebhurauni. Une marata aneruvara rutsvuku uye mafafitera. Miti inemashizha aneruvara rwegirini yakakomberedza mudhuri.

Murume wechikuru unoratidza kuti uri kufambisa mumusoro akapfeka hati huru nehembe yebhuruu inemaoko marefu netirauzi rekhakhi. Nechekusure kwake kunoratidza kuti kune tara mugwagwa urikufamba motokari zhinji , nedzimwe dzakamiswa dzakarunda dzakatarisa rutivi rumwe dzakarongwa zvakanaka.
Midziyo yomumba kana kuti makabati maviri  arimuchitoro arikutengeswa. Makabati acho akapendwa nependi chena, uye akaiswa mapatani mapatani mberi, kuitira kunakisa mumba maanenge aiswa.
Musoro une vhudzi rakarukwa rakaita mitsara mitsara inoenda kugotsi.Bvudzi iri rakasvika robva rasungwa kugotsi rakutevedza muviri wemunhu richidzika.
Chuma chakagadzirwa nechikumba chitema icho chakarukwa rukwa chine simbi yesirivha nechekumativi kwacho chuma chinopfekwa muruoko.

Murume akagara paseri petende. Tende iri rakaiswa padhuze neimba nevamwe varume vatatu vakamira vaviri 
vakamira vachiratidza kuti pane chinhu chavakatarisa.
Dzimba dzekudhorobha, dzinogara vanhu. Dzakavakwa padyo napadyo. Imwechete ine motikari chena. Paine ruzhowa rwesimbi.

Vanhu vanonanamata chitendero cheMoziremu vakamira pamberi pemba vari kuita zvokunamata.  Pamberi pavo pane munhurume akapfeka chinhu chaakazvivhara nacho musoro. Kumasure kune vakamira vakaisa maoko avo pamberi pematundundu avo.
Musikana werudzi rwechichena akarukwa mamutatu zvinobudisa chimiro cheruva.

Chivezwa Chakanaka zvikuru chinonzi wadhiropu chineruvara rutema,chivedzwa zvirikuratidza kuti chirikutengeswa, ASI pakutengeswa kwacho chinogona kuvanemutengo mukuru nokuti Chakanaka zvikuru, chivezwa ichi chinemakamuri akawanda Wanda.
Furegi ine mavara matatu.Nechekuzasi kune vara dema,nechepakati pane vara jena.Kwekupedzisira kumusoro soro kune vara regirini.

Nzvimbo ine dzimba dzakavakwa zvakanaka. Pane imba yakavakwa ikapendwa neruvara rwakachenerukira. Kumusoro kunedenga rine neruvara rutema. Nechomuzasi makanatso vakirirwa zvakanaka zvokuti munhu anogona kutendera pachivanze asina kutsika madhaka.
Mutaro wemagetsi. Panoonekwa danda uye waya zvekare shiri dzakamhara pamusoro pewaya dzemagetsi zvekare pane muti wemupopo murefu uripo.

Shiri yakamhara pabazi remuti. Shiri iyi ineruvara rwakachenerukira nechepadundundu. Nechepahuro inobva yaita ruvara rwutsvuku. Nechekumusana kwayo ineruvara rwutema. Shiri iyi inoratidza kuti inamakumbo zvakare aneruvara rwutema.

Motokari dziri kufamba mumugwagwa. Nepadziri pane zvikwangwani zvakangoiswa zvakawanda uyewo idzo dziri kuti dzimwe dziri kuenda kune rumwe rutivi dzimwe dzichiendawo kuri kubva dzimwe. Pane chena iri kuteererana nemota hombe yemhando yegonyeti.

Chirokari chemaruva chakanaka. Chakagadzirwa nezvidina zvakaita dendenedzwa chikaiswa pendi nhema nechena. Pakati pane maruva akadzwarwa emhando dzakasiyana,  anosanganisa chimwe chikwenzi chakachekererwa zvakanaka.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti pane ivhu rekumatoro. Pane hunyoro kupfurikidza nekuona sora  regirini zvinoratidza kuti pazere mvura. Panewo vakarima chibage chavo, vakachikohwa vasina kana kusakura nekuti muzere sora.
Iyi inzvimbo inoshandirwa nevanhu. Pane motokari yakamira uyewo pane chibhokisi chine mabhanana nechimwe pane fodya nemasuwitsi kutaridza kuti zvinenge zvichitengeswa.
Mhuka inorarama nekudya nyama. Inonzi Shumba. Iyi inamabvindi akatsvukuruka nemamwe matema muhuri ndiyo hono yacho. Dzakavata padivi nayo ihadzi, dzakarara musango.
Wadhiropu yakagadzirwa zvemhando yapamusoro yemapuranga ine ruvara rutema. Yakaiswa girazi pamberi pokuti kana munhu achipfeka anozviringa ipapo. Izvi zvinoitawo kuti
Vanhu kadzi vakawanda vakagara , mumwechete akamira. Parutivi pane tende yakakakwa ichena. Uye motokari dzaka wanda  dzakamira.
Mhando yechitofu chokubikira chinogona kushandiswa magetsi kana kuti gasi. Chine ruvara ruchena negirazi dema rinoona zviri mukati.

Zvimiti zvakachekwa zvakavezwa zvikaita zvimhidu, mhishu - mhishu, zvimhedu zvemiti.Zvakagadzwa pasi pane vhiri  kana kuti taya remotokari rine ruvara rutema. Panzvimbo iyi panoratidza kuti pane vanhu vanogarapo.  Pane mugwagwa unopfura nepo uchiyenda kwauri kuyenda. Necheparutivi panoratidza kuti pane zvivakwa zviripo. Kumberi kunoratidza kuti kune miti yakawanda uye nechepaseri pane mumwe mugwagwa uripo.

Motokari yakamiswa iri yega, ine ruvara rutema runoita kakupenyerera uyeo irikuoneka mafafitera ayo akanyatsosukwa.  Zvakareo iri pedyo nechidziro  kune maruva aripo pedyo nemotikari akadzvarirwa mumagaba.
Shangu idzi dzakavhurika mberi nekumashure. Ruvara rwadzo rutsvuku runezvidodzi-dodzi zvichena. Dzinowanzopfekwa kana kuchipisa.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti yabvawo kurimwa izvo zvinoitirwa kuti vanhu vange vachigonawo kudyara mbesa dzavo. Nechekumativi kwenzvimbo iyi kunewo huswa pamwe chete nemiti.
Mutambi ari kutsvoda muhombe waawina. Ari kuratidza kuti ari kufara. Akapfekawo rokwe refu rine mavara machena. Mumakumbo make ane bhutsu dzakavhurika.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inofambwa neruzhinji sezvo yakapfumba. 
 Nechemujinga macho munoratidza kuti munorashirwa marara. Sezvo mune marara akasiyana  anosanganisira mapepa nezvigubhu  nesora rakaoma. Kumberi kurikubuda  dzimba dzirikuratidza kuti  dzichiri kuvakwa sezvo dzisati dzava nemikova, mafafitera nematenga.

Mukomberedzo wemba wakavakwa namatombo anowadzowanikwa paruvare, uye akaisiwa samende. Mukomberedzo wemba uyu wakanaka. Mujinga mawo mune miti namaruva zvakadyarwa uye huswa huripo hwakachekererwa huneruvara rwegirinhi.
Waya iyo yakamiswa mukati memapango iyo irikuratidza kuti yakakomberedza wo chidziro.  Nechemuzasi mewaya iyi murikuratidza kuti mune mavhu, matombo,tusimbi nezvimwewo zvinhu zvisina basa.
Munhu wechitendero anoratidza kuti arikushumira akabata kenduru riri kupfuta   achitaura na Mwari wake.  Aripanzvimbo inova ine chiremerera yaanenge  achinamatira pasina  ruzha.

Mudzimai akamira pajinga pemuti kuti asarohwe nezuva. Akapfeka nguwo dzineruvara rutema kumusoro nekuzasi. Akapfeka shangu chena uye akabereka bhegi rineruvara rwekirimu. Arikubaya-aya nharembozha yake.
Vanhu vakaungana mukati maimwe nzvimbo  avo   vano  ratidza kuti mune vari kutengesa kozoita vari kutengeserwa. Kuseri kwe  vanhu ava  kunewo  zvivakwa zviriko zvinoitirwa mabasa akasiyana siyana.

Nzvimbo yakapfumba inoratidza kuti inofambwa nemhuka dzakawanda kana nezvipfuyo zvichienda kunomwa mvura sezvo pane pamwe pakadzikira panoratidza kuti igoronga rinombochengeta mvura. Pazasi pacho pane bundo rimwe rakatarangana rinoratidza kuti rinofurwa zvikuru kana kutsikwa nemhuka kana mombe dzichifamba.
Mushonga wemazino unonzi Vigor Doctor mushonga uyu unoita kuti mazino asawore unoshandiswa mazuva ese.
Zvipunu zviviri, forongo imwechete, nebanga rimwechete. Zvakaiswa panogara midziyo iyi, iri midziyo yechimanje manje. Kuitira kushongedza mumba nemadzimai echidiki.
Dhina zvevhu zvakaraswa raswa mudhuri wechitoro une marata waka purasitwa ne simende mugwagwa unofamba vanhu.

Mureza wenyika une mitaro mishanu. Wekutanga kumusoro ndewerudzi rutema, wochiteverwa neruchena wochiteverwa nemutaro werudzi rutsvuku, woteverwa neruchena, woteverwa neruvara rwegirini.  Une mapfumo ayo akapiringishana pakati.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti mudhorobha. Parutivi pomugwagwa pane chivakwa chihombe chakaiswa mafafitera akaiswa magirazi anoratidzira zviri mukati umo makarongedzerwa zvekupfeka zvinosanganisira zvevanhurume nemarokwe avanhukadzi. Munewo shangu nezvimwe zvakatsaukana.
Mukati neruzhohwa rwefenzi, mune miti yemibhanana yakati kuti. Miti iyi yakareba chose. Necheseri kwemiti iyi kunoita sekune gomo rinemiti yemusango.
Mukati medhishi reruvara rwe bhru, mune zvikafu zvakasiyana zvinosanganisira muriwo, bhinzi, nyama  nechingwa zvirimukati medhishi iri.
Chikwata chakapfeka unifomu inehembe dzineruvara rutsvuku nezvikabudura pamwe chete nemasokisi zvineruvara rwendarama. Varikutorwa mufanikiso vasati vatanga kutamba mutambo wavo.
Vanhu vanoratidzika kuva varipadare. Pane murume nemukadzi vakapfeka hembe chena. Mukadzi akabata chirebvu murume akatarisa kumberi.

Vanhu vakawanda vamire, padivi pemugwagwa netara. Mota imwechete chene , yakamira mberi kwavo  ,uye kuseri kwayo kune miti yakareba ne mashirisha egirinhi ,nehuswa wakaoma ne   hushoma hwe girinhi  .  Ngoro dzakamiswa parutivi pevanhu dzisina chinhu
Shangu imwe chete yakatsvetwa pasi. Shangu iyi ineruvara rwakachenerukira. Mukati ineruvara rutema. Inoratidza kuti yakashama kumashure uye nechepazasi yakakwirira chaizvo.
Mune imwe nzvimbo pane wadhiropu yekuisira nhumbi yakagadzirwa zvakanaka. Wadhiropu iyi ine mafafitera maviri pakati payo. Kozoti nekumucheto kwayo kune magonhi akaiswa svumbunuro.

Nzvimbo yemuguta, yakamira motokari zhinji.  Nekwekutanga kunoonekwa murume akapfeka wekisutu uye akabereka bhegi muruoko rwake rworudyi. Pamberi pake motikari panova pane vanhu vaviri varikudarika mugwagwa.

Ndiro dzine chikafu chinoyevedza. Chikafu ichi chinoratidza kuti chakabikwa nenyanzvi uye chakabikwa nenzira yepamusoro. Muchikafu ichi munosanganisira nyama yakatsvukira nemachipisi anoratidza kuti akagadzirwa nematapura.

Imba ine marata ane ruvara ruchena. Imba iyi yakavakwa nezvitinha nesemende. Ine chidziro chine semende uye mafafitera akawanda asati aiswa. Kumberi kwemba iyi kune bindu remuriwo rine hanyanisi nekovho. Padivi pebindu iri pane muti wemumango une maruva.
Hunde yemuti yakagadzirwa kuita chigaro chakanaka kwazvo, ine ruvara rwebhurauni nerwekurimu chakatsvetwa pasi pane ruvara rupfumbu

Chikafu chakarongedzwa ndokuiswa mundiro pane mupunga uripo poitawo nyama yenguruve poita chibage poitawo makotopeya akachetwa zvakanaka noumwe murivo.Chikafu ichi chinovakwa muviri zvikuru nokuti zvese zvinodawo nemuviri munhu anozviwana paanenge achichidya.
Bundo rakawanda rakasvibira riine marudzi akasiyana nezvidhongi zvinobaya zvisati zvaoma.
Mhuka dzemusango.  Nzou dzihombe dzirikufamba nedzimwe diki ,nekamwana kadiki.

Pakati pedhorobheni rine zvivakwa zvemudirukidzanwa zvizhinji  kwazvo, pari kuonekekwa robhoti iro rinomisa  motikari  kuti dzifambe pamwe nekupesana mune zvakanaka. Vanhu ringori besanwa vachikwira nekudzika.
Pamba pana amai vakapfega hembe ine ruvara rwemvura, nemwanasikana akapfega hembe tsvuku nekamwana kakomana kakasvuurwa musoro, paine nhumbi dziri pamutariko dzakawachwa.

Masimbi akakomberedza chivakwa uyezve mukati memasimbi aya muri kuratidzawo kuva neuswa hwakamera. Humwe hwaoma hwave neruvara rwebhurawuni. Humwe huchiri hwegirini. Nechapasi apa pakaraswawo zvigubhu zvinoratidza kuti zvakambonwirwa zvinwiwa. Uyezve kune mugwagwa une motokari dziri kupesana.
Pamberi pechimwe chitoro pane zvidhina zvakawanda zvakarongwa. Chitoro ichi chine gonhi rimwe rakavhurika. Nechemberi kwezvidhinha izvi kune murume ari kuzvifambira.

Mhuka dzemusango dzirikuratidza kuti dzirikuzvifurira hadzo uye dziri munzvimbo inoratidza kuti ine huswa hwakaisvonaka uye mune miti dzakasiyana siyana izvi zvinoratidza kuti mhuka dziri kuguta kwazvo mushure mekunge dzichidya mashizha neuswa zviri panzvimbo iyi.

Miti iri musango. Pane umwe chete unoita sewakaoma une tutsotso twakakwira kuenda mudenga asi tunoyevedza kutarisa. Koitawo imwe miti ine mashizha ayo ane ruvara rwegirini yakamira umwe uri uko umwe uri uko. Pakati payo hapana chinhu rinongori gwenga rine majecha.

Paguva pari kuvakirirwa zvinoratidza kuti mune munhu abva mukuchengetwa kana kuti mufi kana kuti mushakabvu vari kuvakira nematanda pamusoro uye munhu wacho akapfekedzwa nhumbi chena arimo mukati mushakabvu uyu.

Mugwagwa wakapamhamha une tara. Nechekujinga kwemugwagwa uyu tiri kuona mudhuri wakakomberedza musha une dzimba dzakavakwa zvakanaka dzikapfurirwa nemazen'e. Pane mukomana arikufamba pazambuko repamugwagwa uyu anoratidza kuti arikudimbura mugwagwa.

Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa nefenzi. Inoratidza kuti igomo riri kuenda kuchiwonekwa miti nehuswa huchikwidza gomo. Miti mizhinji ine mashizha eruvara rwebumhudza uye pane huswa humwe hwakatsvukira hune ruvara rwepfumbu hudziratidza kuoma. Uchikwira kumusoro kunoonekwawo matombo.
Mbatata nhatu dzakatsvetwa pasi dzakakaiwa kobva dzagezwa unogona kudzicheka wotogadzira machipisi.
Zvitoro zvinowanikwa panzvimbo yezvitoro yekumusha, zvinobatanidza zvigayo uye zvimwe zvacho zvakapendwa neruvara rwegirinhi, zvimwe hazvina kupendwa.
Zvipanera zvemizera yakasiyanasiyana. Zvinoshandiswa navagadziri vemotokari. Zvinoshandiswa zvakare navanogadzira mishini yakasiyanasiyana. Zvinoshanda pakusunungura mabhaudhi.
Bindu rine maruva akawanda. Maruva aya anotambarara uye mamwe acho ari kutotambarara achitevedzera fenzi achikwira kumusoro. Ane mashizha maduku uye mashizha aya ane ruvara rwegirinhi.

Murume murefu, muchena, ane vhudzi rakareba uye rakanaka rakanosvika kumapendekete. Akapfeka nhumbi dzaipfekwa pasi chigare, dzinova rokwe rakanoita jena asi rakanoita futi pfumbu. Murume uyu anoratidza saJesu paari

Shangu imwe yekwarudyi inoratidza kuti imhando yetenisi zvekare ichitatamuka. Haina kana zvibhande kana tambo dzekubata kuti ishinye. Pasi payo pane rabha yeruchena yakakwirira zvikuru 
inoratidza kuti mutefetefe pakutsika uchifamba nayo.

Zhou iri  padziva rine mvura nemadhaka. Iri kuzvidira mvura nekuda kwekupisa kwezuva. Mberi kwayo kune huswa hwakaoma. Nechemberizve kune miti ina mashizha akasiyana-siyana mamwe akasvibira ane ruvara rwegirini mamwe akatsvukuruka.
Mureza mumwe chete une mucheka unopenya une ruvara ruchena kumusoro neruvara rutsvuku kuzasi.

Shangu inoratidza kuti ine ruvara rwakaita pingi yakachenuruka. Ine ruvara rwakanyorwa kuti Eni nechepadivi. Pamusoro paine maburi aripo asina tambo. Mukati mune ruvara rwebhurauni. Shangu iyi yakagara pasi pane ruvara ruchena . Inoratidza kuti ichakasimba shangu iyi asi yakambopfekwa.

Musikana arimunhandare arikufara zvikuru.  Akabata mukombe.  Zvinoratidza kuti vakunda mumutambo wavanga vachitamba.  Akapfeka zvipfeko zvitsvuku akasunga musoro wake vhudzi rake.  Kumashure kwake kune vamwe vatambi varikuonekwa munhandare.

Mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari dzichienda kwakasiyana-siyana.Nechepadivi pemugwagwa uyu panewo munhurume akamira akapfeka bhibhi regirini rinoratidza kuti anotengesawo eyatayimu.Uye pamberi pake pane tebhuru yakawaridzwawo zvinhu zvakawanda zvinoratidza kuti ari kutengesa.

Bindu rakadzvarwa zvinhu zvakasiyana. Kuruboshwe kune chibage chiriko  chakamira chine mashanga akutoda kuoma. Choteverwawo nemaruva akawanda omuheji ari mutumapepa tutema anogona kutotengeswa uyewo nechokurudyi kune mamwe mapepa ari mutuheji asi pane pamwe pane murivo wetsunga uri kuoneka wakasvibira zvakanaka.
Motokari dziri kufamba mumugwagwa wakaiswa tara. Padivi pemugwagwa pane zvitoro zvakavakwa  uye zvikwangwani zvinoshambadza unoonekwa miti inosanganoisira mijakaranda ina maruva.
Musoro wemunhukadzi.Une bvudzi rakasvibira uye rakarukwa madhiredzi matsvuku.Rimwe vhudzi rakabatwa neruwoko rwakapfeka chiringazuva.
Ruva rinokura richienda mudenga semuti. Rina mapazi akawanda uye rina maruva aneruvara rutsvuku. Mashizha omuti uyu akareba asi akatetepa. Ane ruvara rwe girinhi.
Vanhukadzi  vakamira  vamwe vazhinji vacho vakasunga misoro yavo namadhuku. Vakapfekawo nhumbi dzina mavara akasiyana-siyana uye vari kuita sekuti vanonanata. Vakawanda vacho vakakotamisa uso hwavo.
Nzvimbo iyi inevanhu vakawanda varikufamba. Inoita sekuti panotengesewa zvinhu, pane madzimai akatakura mabhegi anezvinhu.

Vanhu vari munhandare varikutamba mutambo wekiriketi. Pane akapfeka mbatya dzeyero akapfeka heti mumusoro. Uyewo akapfeka zvekuzvidzivira pakukuvara pamabvi. Kunevamwewo vakapfeka mbatya dzegirinhi vari kunerumwe rutivi.

Vanhu vazhinji varatidza kuti varikuita zvakasiyana. Vanosanganisira varume navakadzi. Vamwe vari kufamba vamwe vakamira uye pane matende akaita semaamburera. Pasi pematende aya pari kutengwa zvunhu zvakasiyana zvinosanganisira zvimwiwa nezvidyiwa.
Chinwiwa chine ruvara rutema chinotumidzwa zita rekuti kokakora. Icho chakadirwa mugirazi ndobva chaiswa chando kuti ringe richitonhorera izvo zvinoita kuti ange achinzwa kuzipirwa.
Muchero unorimwa pamba unonzi mumengo. Aya achiri mambishi. Muti uyu ichiri mudiki zvakare.
Zvifambiso zvinotakura vanhu zvakamira pachiteshi. Zvakanyorwa zvakasiyana-siyana kukwezva vafambi.
Chikafu chakabikwa zvinonwisa mvura, chiri mundiro uye chinosanganisira mupunga wakaiswa une muto uye nyama yakakangwa yakatsvukirira.
Kabati yakagadzirwa nepuranga ine ruvara rwebhurauni. Ine madhirowa ekuisira zvinhu, pasi pana matayira ane ruvara ruchena.
Mhuka dzesango dzinoratidza kuti dzakatsika nzvimbo iyi inoratidza kuti idhamu rakapera mvura. Madhaka Aya akaoma nekuda kwekushaikwa kwemvura aneruvara rupfumbu.

Zvirimwamwa zvakawanda zvakasiyana zveshanga diki zviri mumasaga makuru zvobva zvazopimwa. Zvimwe zvakapimirwa murusero zvimwe zvakapimirwa mumagaba nemakapu zvichiratidza kuti zvinotengeswa. Zvirimwa izvi zvinosanganisira zviyo, nyimo nenzungu.

Nzvimbo yemuguta. Murume akamira akabata chingoro chine mabhanana nemaeporo nezvigubhu zviviri zvakasungirirwa  kumberi kumashure kwake kune motokari dzakamira dzakawanda. Nechekumberi kwemotokari kunowonekwa midhuri yemuturikidzaniswa

Chikafu chinoratidza kunaka chineruvara rwakasangana-sangana. Ruvara rwegirini, rweyero neruvara rutsvuku uyezve pane bhawera rineruvara ruchena nechikafu chebhurauni nechichena chinoratidza kuti chakaita semakeke. Parutivi panezvitsvuku uye zvinoratidza kuti michero iripo.

Motokari yakanaka ineruvara rwebhuru yakasvibira, yakashongedzwa nemachira, motokari iyi yakashongedzwa nemachira aneruvara rwepingi nemachena, nechemuzasi inejira rineruvara rwepingi neruchena zvekare.
Vanhu varimunhandare inotambirwa mutambo wezve bhora.  Vaviri uyewo pane mumwe akakotama.  Poita mumwe arikufamba akananga kune kabhora  kadiki kachena.  Uyewo pane tusimbi tutatu twakachererwa pasi.

Mharadzano dzemigwagwa isina tara. Parutivi rwacho pakamira mota chena. Nechokusure kwemota iyi kunevanhu vakagara vamwe vakamira, vazhinji vavo vakapfeka magemenzi machena zvichibva zvaita kuti tifungidzire kuti vatenderi vechipositori vari pakirawa kana kuti varipakereke havo.
Pane zvuma zvakaiswa pa tafura,  zvuma izvi zvakasiyana siyana, kusanganisira zvimwe  zve zvuma zvine ruvara rwe denga  kozoita zvimwe zvine ruvara ruchena.  Patafura iyi pakachena.
Murume mumwechete mutema, anotamba mutambo wetsiva, akabata mhenduru dzake dzekukunda.

Zvivezwa. Midziyo yokuisira zvivhitivhiti kana kuisira mabhuku nezvimwewo zvakadaro kana kuisa chikafu. Ine ruvara ruchena nerutema uyewo nemagirazi nemadhirowa ekudhonza ane ruvara rwepepuro neruvara rweyero.
Zvifananidzo zvevashandi umwe akaisa maoko mudenga,  mumwe akabata bhara  vakapfeka mahovhorosi, vakasungira  muchiuno, vakapfeka jombo, mumwe akagara pasi aine ngowani ine ruvara rwakatsvukuruka.

Madzimai akachonjomara matatu. Vakasunga mazambia. Vose vane matisheti machena uye vane ndazi mumisoro yavo. Vamwe vakagadzirwa misoro vakarukwa uye vane mawigi. Kumashure vakamira uye pakati pavo pane varume.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuva pazvitoro. Pane chitoro chine mukova wakashama chine vanhu varikupinda. Pamberi pechitoro pane marara akawanda.
Mujinga merimwe  gomo mune chivakwa  chakanaka chakavakwa ipapo. Chivakwa ichi chakareba kwazvo  uyezve chine makamuri akawanda. Zvinoratidzika kuti pane vanhu vakamira pamusuwo wechivakwa ichi.
Munhu akamira akabata ngamera yake. Iyo yakamira uye ine pamwe pakatutumara pamusana. Yakaiswa tambo muhuro mayo. Kuseri kwayo kune mufananidzo wechimwedzi chakachekwa.
Mbatatisi dziri mumasagi makuru nemadiki.   Dzakaiswa pamberi pechitoro.   Parutivi pane chimwe chitoro chiri kutengesa miriwo  pamwe nemichero dzakasiyana -siyana.
Ruoko rwomunhu rwakabata sipunu hombe yesimbi. Rurikushandura raisi jena rakasvibira rakasangana ne supu uye riri mu poto yesimbi hombe.
Motokari dziri kufamba mumugwagwa mukuru dziri kuda kutopesana. Kurutivi kwacho kune mudhuri wakavakwa kudzivirira zvivakwa zviri mukati uye kune miti.
Dutavanhu hombe rineruvara rwe yero nerutema rwakanyorwa nezvichena padumbu. Rinemafafitera akasvibira. Parutivi parwo panemotikari chena.
Chitoro chine mhete dzemuhuro dzepanzeve nedze muzvigunwe dzewanano nezvindarira zvemumaoko zvine mavara akasiyana zvimwe zvegoridhe zvimwe zvesirivha.

Mugwagwa une tara unoratidza kuti vawa nenguva huru wagadzirwa sezvo uchiratidza kuti wawa kuchereka kumativi kwavo. Nechekune rimwe rutivi kune matombo makuru mana. Kuseri kwematombo aya kune mashedhi akaiswa zvinhu zvakawanda zvinoratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa.
Munda wechibage uri kuratidza kuti une chibage hwakasvibirira chakasvika hachisati chaibva asi vana vechibage vakaburitsa ndebvu.
Ngoro mbiri dzakamira. Motokari ine ruvara rwesirivha yakamira yerudzi rweHonda fit. Chikwangwani chiri pamudhuri chakanyorwa neruvara rutsvuku nerwegirini.
Mudhorobheni, vanhu varikufamba vachipesana panofambwa netsoka nevanhu musiri mumugwagwa chaimo, padivi pezvitoro. Vamwe vakamira panzvimbo inotengeswa mbatatisi dzakapiswa mumafuta.
Pedyo nedzimwe dzimba pane miti irikudonhedza mashizha arikuita murakwani. Miti iyi yakasiyana siyana. Nechemberi kwemiti iyi kune heji yakachekererwa.

Ruzhinji rwevanhu rwunosanganisira vanhukadzi nevanhurume vari kufamba mudhorobha variparutivi pebhanga nemashopu akasiyana. Zvinoita kuti vange vawane rubatsiro havo rwakasiyana, izvo zvinoita kuti nyika ienderere mberi.

Vanhu vakasiyanasiyana vakagara kuma girini sitembi vanhu ava vanoratidza kuti vane mutambo wavari kuona, vakawanda vachona vakapfeka zvingowani kune vamwe vakapfeka ngowani ine ruvara rutema vamwe vakapfeka ngowani dzine ruvara rwebhuruu, koita musikana wakafuratira wakapfeka hembe ine ruvara rwebhuruu kumusoro kuzasi wakapfeka chikabudura chegirini.

Mune umwe mugwagwa pane murume ari kusunda ngoro akabereka kabheki.    Ngoro iyi inoita kunge ine zvinhu zvakatakurwa zvinorema.   Pedyo  nemurume uyu pane mudzimai akapfeka hembe chena uyezve neheti chena.
Maturusi akasiyana anosananganisira foshoro, bhara, bhidha nedemo. Zvinoshanda mabasa akasiyana anoti kutema miti kuchera makomba. Izvo zvinoita kuti basa rive nyore.

Vana varikuratidza kuti varikutamba zuva rava kundodoka. Varikutamba zvavo vachidzingirirana, mumwe wevana ava akapfeka hembe tsvuku mumwe ane ine mitaro mitaro. Varikufara vana ava vachiratidza kuti ndeve mudhorobheni.

Masora emhando dzakasiyana akasangana. Pane mamwe aneruvara rwegirinhi uyewo nemashizha akawanda. Poitawo mamwe anemashizha anenge tunda arikureba emutsanga. Akangosangana akadaro zvokuti nzvimbo yacho irikuyevedza kutarisa.

Motokari dziri kufamba dzichipesana mumugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara.  Motokari idzi dzine ruvara rwuchena zhinji dzacho.   Kumativi emugwagwa uyu kune miti yakawanada ine mapazi akawanda namashizha ane ruvara rwegirinhi.   Imwe ine maruva ane ruvara rwepepuru.

Muti wemugwavha wakabereka. Muti uyu mukuru asi pari kuonekwa  padhuze ndepakaberekwa magwavha  akarembera. Une mazhizha akakura anetwunhu twunenge twutsinga  twunofambisa mvura nechikafu uyewo magwavha chikafu chigona kudyiwa chakangodaro kana chakasangana nemimwe michero.

Mota chena yedhabhuru kebhi yakamira padivi pedenderedzwa rine maruva akasiyana mukati egirini mamwe marefu anemashizha mamwe anemashizha mapfupi akachekererwa, pamusoro pemota pane mumvuri webhuruu unemasimbi machena.

Nzvimbo yakapfumba chose inoratidza kuti inofambwa neveruzhinji. Nechekumberi kwacho tikuona midhuri yakavakwa zvakada kundofanana ikafuratira divi rimwe. Imwe miviri yakapendwa nependi yakando kunochenerukira imwe miviri yakangopurasitwa ikasiiwa isina  kupendwa. Midhuri iyi inoratidza kuti zvitoro. Mumwe munotengeswa gasi rokubikisa.

Varume vaviri vakamira. Mumwechete  akapfeka hembe yebhruu uye ane chiringazuva muruoko rwake. Mumwe akapfeka nguwo chena akaisa jira tsvuku muhuro make akabata tsvimbo. Anoratidza kuti mutendi wemasowe.

Nzvimbo inomirirwa dzimotokari iri parutivi nemugwagwa. Pane vanhu vakabata mabhegi vamwe ndeve zvingoro vakaisa zvingoro zvavo pasi. Kune murume wakapfeka hembe dzine ruvara rwebhuruu poita mudzimai wakapfeka hembe ine ruvara ruchena ane dhuku riri musoro rine ruvara ruchena.

Nzvimbo inevanhu vakasiyana-siyana varikufamba. Panemurume wakapfeka hembe ineruvara ruchena kuzasi anemutirauzi uneruvara rutema. Mutsoka wakapfeka shangu dzineruvara rutema kuzasi dzineruvara ruchena. Koita mudzimai arikufamba akapendekera bhegi. Ane bhegi rineruvara rutema uye akapfeka hembe chena kumusororo kuzasi akapfeka siketi ineruvara rutema.
Mudziyo wemumba yekubikira unonzi Iwo kabati unoisirwa ndiro nezvekushandisa zvemadzimai zvakaita sezvekunwira makapu uye maforogo nemapanga.

Maruva akarimwa panzimbo imwechete akasiyana siyana.Mamwe ane tushizha twudiki diki tutete mamwewo anemashizha mahombe. Pane maruvara aneruvara ruchena uye yero zvekare kunemamwe anemashizha epepuro .Ose ari  muzvipepa zvitema.
Muti wemumango uriparudivi pe juraworo yakavakwa nezvidhinha zvesimende zve gireyi. Muzasi mayo mune miti midiki uye zvisimwa zviri mugaba. Pasi pane jecha re bhurauni uye nemamwe matombo.
Mharadzano dzemugwagwa netara, pamharadzano apa panokondurorewa nema robhotsi pane vanhu  vazhinji vari kuita zvakasiyana varume nevakadzi vamwe vari kufamba vamwe vakamira vachitengesa zvakasiyana.

Mugwagwa une tara. Mumugwagwa umu mune vanhu vari kuita zvakasiyana. Vamwe vakamira vamwe vari kufamba vachiratidza kuti vari kubira mugwagwa uyu. Pane mumwe murume ari kusunda chingoro chakagadzwa nezvinhu zvakaputirwa nebepa dema. Nechekune  rumwe rutivi kuri kuratidza motokari dzinotakura veruzhinji dziri kuratidza kuti dziri kuita majana ekutakura vanhu.

Imba yakakomberedzwa neruzhowa rwatinoti rukato uye maruva aripo uye 
 pane muti uri kunze unoratidza semuti wemuchero
Imba yehuswa, ine mawindo maviri , nemusuwo umwe chete   zvine ruvara rwakasvibira rwebhureki .Yaka pfirirwa nehuswa .
Nzvimbo yakanaka inoyevedza ine matombo makuru anoratidza kuti  anonakidza kugara sezvo pane miti yakapfumvutira yakasvibira inoratidza kuti ine bvute rinotonhorera chaizvo.
Guva rakacherwa rikavakirwa nezvidhinha kubva pasi kusvika pakaenzana nokureba kwebhokisi rechitunha.
Chiumbwa chemunhu chakapfekedzwa hembe ine mavara matsvuku nemachena, uyewo chakaberekeswa bhegi muruoko rweruboshwe. Kumadziro kunoonekwa mabhegi akaturikwa.

Vanhu vari munhandare vari kutamba mutambo webhora vakapfeka mbatya chena uyewo dzakanyorwa nezvimwe kumusana zvitema. Mumaoko mune mamwe mavara aripo. Vakapfeka masokisi marefu vazhinji vacho. Zvakare pane mumwe chete akapfeka chimwe chinenge chikabudura chiri pasi pechimwe.
Miti ine mashizha akasvibira nemamwe akoama. Miti iyi iri mugoronga.   Parutivi pegoronga pane nzira isina kunyatsopfumba.

Shangu dzinopfekwa nemunhukadzi dzakagadzikwa pasi dzakavhurika kumativi ose kuti dzinge dzichipinza 
mhepo  kumashure kwadzo kwakakwirira zvakare dzine mabhande pamusoro padzo ayo anobata tsoka kana dzichinge dzapfekwa.
Imba yakavakwa nezvidhinha ine mafasitera nedenga rakanaka, panze paine kamuti kamwechete.

Bhazi guru rinorakidza kuti idzva rinopenya rakamira mujinga memugwagwa une tara. Bhazi iri riri kuratidza kuti riri kutotakura veruzhinji. Rinoratidza kuti ndeaya anobva kune dzimwe nyika achienda kudzimwe nyika sezvo richiratidza kuti rinofamba mitunhu mikuru sezvo rine mavhiri akawanda anosvika matanhatu.
Masiripasi maviri imwe ndeyemwana mudiki yeyero inemavara matsvuku yakashama pamusoro nekumberi inemabhande ebhuru arikumusoro mukati mayo muchena.
Vatambi vetsiva varikutorwa mifananidzo vakasimudza maoko avo mudenga, mumwechete ndiye akapfugama pamberi pevamwe vose.
Motokari mbiri dzirikupesana mumugwaga. Irikurudyi iHonda Fit chena. Kumberi kwayo kune miti irikuonekwa ine mashizha akasvibira.
Mutomatisi une mashizha katsvukuruka uye une mashizhà aneruva gwegurinhi nemamwe aneruvara gweyero.

Motikari huru dzakati wandei, dzakamiswa dzinozivikanwa nekunzi magonyeti. Dzimwe dzacho dzinotakura dzimwe mota. Mujinga nemotokari idzi mune mudhuri wakanaka, wakavakwa zvakanaka unopenya unoratidza kuti nzvimbo iyi iri mudhorobha.
Chitoro chine nhumbi dzakasiyana muna marokwe ana mavara matema, machena, epingi, epurple. Mune ngowani dzine mavara akasiyana, mune zvipika zvine mavara akasiyana.

Imba yakavakwa zvakanaka. Imba iyi yakapendwa neruvara rwegireyi yobva yaita matombo akashandiswa kuvaka. Matombo aya ane ruvara ruchena neruvara rwebhurauni. Nechekunze kune heji iripo yakanatso chekererwa zvakanaka yakaita chibhora. Heji iyi ine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirinhi.

Murume arikufamba achipfuura panotengesewa mawhindo, murume uyu akapfeka ngowani tema mumusoro ina magirazi uye akapfeka hovhorosi ine ruvara rwebhuruu asi yakasviba, akabata ndiro yakavharika ine ruvara rwegirini.

Mugwagwa une tara muri kufamba motikari. Mugwagwa uyu unoratidza kuti pamharadzano sezvo pane marobhotsi. Pane vanhu vari kuita zvakasiyana, vamwe vakamira zvavo , vamwe vari kufamba vamwe vari kukirosa mugwagwa uyu vamwe ndivo vakagara vakaisa zvinhu pasi  vachiratidza kuti vari kutengesa.
Nzou ne mvuu zvirikufamba panzvimbo imwechete. Nzou idzi dzakakura uye dzine nzeve dzakakura zvakare. Nzvimbo yadziri inemakomo akawanda ázere miti nehuswa hwakawanda hune ruwara rwe girini.

Shangu dziri kuda kutengeserwa vanhu dzakaiswa pasi dzakawanda. Zhinji dzacho dzakavharika uye dzino pfekwa nevanhukadzi zvose nevanhurume. Pane dzimwe nhema poita dzimwe chena, uye dzakagadzikwa imwe iri pamusoro peimwe.
Vhasi  rirefu regoridhe. Rakadzirwa mavara mavara senzira eokuzvishongedza. Vhasiri rine maruva mamiri erudzi rwakasiyana siyana. Maruva rimwe rine mitsara michena rimwe racho rinongova regirinhi.
Mugwagwa une ivhu jena rine rubwe, parutivi pane mudhuri wejurahoro wakakomberedza imba hombe ine marata matsvuku.
Kumusika kunotengeserwa zvinhu zvakasiyana-siyana. Vanosona vakamira pedyo vanemicheka yakasiyana-siyana uyezve nemudzimai anotengesa madomasi akabereka mwana kumusana nemadengu akasiyana-siyana.
pedjo nemugwagwa panegurumwandirwa remarara emando dzakasiyana, kusanganisira zvigubhu,machira nemamwe marara  anoita se akapiswa,nechekumhiri kwemarara  kunedzimba zviriko

Midziyo iri kuratidza kuti iri munzvimbo yaino gadzirirwa yakaita sama kicheni yuniti. Iyo inoshandisa kurongedzerwa midziyo inoshandiswa muimba yekubikira navanhu. Yakapendewawo namakara akasiyana siyana uye irikuratidza kuti yakamiswa mumitsetse kuti vanhu vanyotsoona vasati vatenga.

Mumugwagwa wemotokari wakagadzirwa zvakanaka. Mune motokari mbiri dzirikufamba dzakasiyana rudzi uye mavara. Motokari idzi imwe ichena imwe ndeyeruvara rwesirivha. Nechekumhiri kwacho kune kune vanhu varikufamba mumugwagwa unoratidza kuti mugwagwa mudiki pane uyo  wemotokari.

Bundo rakasvibira chose rinoratidza kuti rinowana mvura yakakwana sezvo richiratidza kuti rakamera pamusoro pemvura uye ravhara mvura . Parutivi pacho pane bundo riya rinonyanya kufarira kumera mumvura zvakare rinonzi shanga.
Mudhorobha. Vanhu vazhinji vari kufamba. Parutivi pane motokari dzakamira uye  zvivakwa zvakawanda zvakasiyana siyana zvakareba.
Varume vanomhanya.Vose vatambi venhabvu.Vari munhandare.Vose vakapfeka hembe dzegirini kumusoro nezvikabudura zveyero zvine ruvara rutsvuku kuzasi.Shure kwavo kune zvigaro zvegirini nezvitsvuku.
Midziyo inoshandiswa muimba yekubikira inosanganisira madheka emagirazi uye magirazi anoshandiswa pakunwisa mvura kana zvinwiwa zvakasiyana siyana.
Kamuti kanotambarara kane maruva e"purple". Iderere rinotambarara rinodyiwa. Kumwe riri kuratidza kuoma asi kumwe riri kuratidza kuti harisati raoma. Derere iri nderemusango.
Mhando yechifambiso chinotakura vanhu riri bhazi rekwaJoray rine ruvara rutsvuku nerweyero pambabvu rinoenda kwaMutare rakananga nekwaRusape. Panoonekwawo mwenje inoshandisa simba rezuva.
Nzvimbo yaka gadzirwa ine huswa hwaka chekererwa zvakanaka, paine miti iripo imwe mikuru nemumwe mudiki

Zvekudya zvirimundiro  ine ruvara ruchena.  Munesadza jena , nemuriwo we girinhi,  nenyama yakatsvukirira inoratidza kuva nyama yehove.  Kudya uku kunovaka muviri uye kunodiwa nevazhinji nokuti kunosimbisa muviri zvakare.
Vanhu vakamira vari munzvimbo inodzidzirwa, pane zvinhu zvinoshandiswa nevana vadiki zvakaiswa pamberi , pane manhamba akanyorwa neruvara rutsvuku, ruvara rwebhuruu uye ruvara rwegirini.
Varume vakapfeka nhumbi dzichena nemabhandi matema vasina kupfeka shangu. Vari kuratidza kuti vari kudzidzira kuita mutambo wekarati.

Vanhu vakamira mumwe akabereka bhegi ane hembe tsvuku mumwe akaisa bhegi rake parutivi ane hembe chena mumwe ane hembe yake neruvara ruchena inoratidza kuti ndeye kuchechi namabheki machena nedhuku vose vakatarisa divi rimwe chete rinoratidza kuti kunenge kune motokari kana kuti  bhazi ravakatarisira kuti rinogona kuvatakura.
Sadza nemuriwo wakasvibira zviri mundiro pamwechete neusavi hwehove. Zviri mundiro yakagadzikwa patafura.
Mai vakabata mwana wavo. Varume vamwe vacho vakatakura mabhegi avo. Mabhanzi anotengesewa aine kirimu ari mukereti. Kaimba kadiki, shedhi.

Mureza inamavara akasiyana siyana. Tichibva kumusoro ndichienda kuzasi Kune ruvara rwebhuruwu kouya ruvara ruchena, kouya rwutsvuku kouya zvakere ruvara ruchena kouya ruvara bhuruwu. Necheparutivi pane mifananidzo nyernyedzi dzakaita denderedzwa dzineruvara rweyero.
Chikafu ichi chinorimwa mumunda, chinoita zvekucherwa pasi. Madhumbe chikafu chinorimwa panzvimbo inenge ichiyerera mvura yakawanda kana mujinga merwizi. Kana chabikwa chinofanana nembambaira.

Gavakava riri pakati pesango rakakomberedzwa nemahuswa akawoma. Sango iri rine miti yakawanda ine mapazi akawanda. Mashizha emiti iyi ane ruvara rwegirini.
Matanda marefu anotaridza tambo dziri kumusoro dzemagetsi uye pane rusvingo ruripo rwakakomberedza nzvimbo iyi pamwe chete nematanda akaita madoko ari kunze.

Dzimba zhinji dzimwe dzacho ihuru dzinoratidza kuti dzakavakwa nemitoo yakasiyana. Nechekunze kwacho kune miti yakawanda zvimwe zvacho zvinoratidza kuti zvikwenzi zvakazobukira mushure mekunge miti mikuru yatemwa. Muzvikwenzi umu muri kubudira sora rakawanda rakaoma.

Mudzimai ari kuuchira maoko.Akapfeka risitibhendi chena.Mumusoro ane dhuku chena.Parutivi pake panamai vari kusekerera vakapfeka zvitsvuku nevamwe vanesheti yemachekidhi enevhi bhuruu nezvichena.Pasi pane pikicha yakanyorwa kunzi Precise seeking.
Murume ari kusvetuka achijaivha ngoma, haana hembe. Kuzasi akapfeka mhapa neshashiko yeminhenga yeshiri ina mavara machena, yero nebhuru.

Kamba, kamba inavana vayo vatanhatu varikuoneka. Vana ava vaneruvara ruchena neruvara rutema namakumbo akaita yero. Mai vekamba vanamakwanba makwamba ebhuruwu nematema nerimwe ruvara rweorenji kana kuti rweyero. Mumakumbo makaita ruvara rweorenji.
Muri murefu une mashizha aneruvara rwegirini. Uine matavi akatarangana akatarisa mativi akasiyana siyana.

Mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari uyewo vanhu. Pane munhu ari kufamba achienda kwaanoenda. Nechekudivi kwemugwagwa kune fenzi iriko yakakomberedza nzvimbo ine motokari dzakawanda chaizvo dziri kutengeswa.
Munhu ari paruware. Mabwe makuru kwazvo. Mudhuri wakadonha. Muti une mashizha ane ruvara rwegirinhi. Bundo rine ruvara rwegirinhi.

Vari kufamba zvavo mumugwagwa vamwe vari kufamba muzasi mezvivakwa nemotokari dziri mumugwagwa une tara dzimwe dzacho dzinoratidza kuti imotokari dzokutakura voruzhinji pane zvivakwa zvimwe zvemuturikidzana zvinobva zvatiratidza kuti mudhorobheni.

Vanhu vakapfeka hembe dzekutambisa mutambo.Vakamira vari vaviri vaviri vachidhonzana maoko.Hembe dzavo hadzina kufanana,vamwe vakapfeka dzakasiyana nevamwe.Uyezve shangu dzavo hadzina kufanana,dzakasiyana siyana.Vari kudhonzana maoko.Kunze kwenhandare kune vakagara pazvigaro vari kuona zvavari kuita.

Pamusika panotengeswa zvinhu zvakasiyana paneo vanhu vakawanda varikufamba vamwe vachitenga vamwe vachitengesa. Pane chingoro chirikusundwa chine masaga mukati. Paneo mudzimai akapfeka chikipa chichena akabereka mwana netauro rine mutsetse mitsvuku nemichena.
Chuma chakagadzirwa nesimbi chine ruvara rwesirivha.Chakagadzikwa pasi.Vamwe vanopfeka chuma ichi muhuro.Vamwewo ndivo vanochipfeka muruwoko.Chuma chinowedzera mucheno kunyanya kuvakadzi.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuva pakati pedhorobha pane mugwagwa une motikari dzakawanda dzirikufamba. Pane imwe motikari chena yakamira parutivi pemugwagwa.
Kabati imwe chete ine masherufu mashanu. Ndeyemuti uye ine ruvara rwebhurauni. Parutivi pane chidziro chesimende.

Nzvimbo ine sora rakasvibira. Nechekumberi kune maruva akachekererwa zvakaenzana akakomberedza mudhuri wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvitsvuku. Nechokumashure kune nhokwe dzakasvibira uye mamwe masora akacheneruka.

Murume akapfeka hembe tema, nguwani tema nebhurugwa reruvara rwepfumbu. Akafuratira mataira  emotikari akagarisana ari matema. Nechekumashure kwema taira aya kune vanhu varikutengesa pamisika yavo vachitengesa zvakasiyana siyana zvinova zvimwe zvanga zvakachengetwa mumu gomo.
Ndiro imwechete yedhaga ichena. Ine chikafu chinoti mupunga wakatsvukira, nyama yehuku yakakangwa, mashizha epesiri nemuto wakagadzirwa nemadomasi nehanyanisi.

Munhukadzi akapfeka chuma muhuro make chine mipata mitatu iyo yakagadzirwa namachira nezvimwewo zvakasiyana siyana zvakare china mavara ane bhuruu, machena namatsvuku izvi zvinopfekerwa kushongedza miviri yavanhu.
Vakadzi vanofamba pachikoro. Vanoratidza kuti vadzidzi. Pamberi pavo pane zvivakwa zvokudzidzira zvine midhuri ine mavara machena kumusoro netsvuku kuzasi.

Chingoro chakamira chiri padivi pebhazi. Chingoro ichi chine ruvara rwebhuruu uye chine mufananidzo wechinwiwa chepepusi. Padivi pechingoro ichi pane dutavanhu rekambani inonzi Rimbi, dutavanhu iri rineruvara rwebhuruu uye rakanyorwa namavara matema.
Zvinyoreso zviviri zvine ruvara rutema kumashure uye ruvara rwedenga mberi zvinoshandiswa kunyora pamabhodhi.
Murume akamira pedo nemadziro ane ruvara rwebhuruu. Akabata bhegi muruoko rwake aine bhachi mune rumwe ruoko. Akapfeka hembe yakaita chena aine matenesi mutsoka dzake nemudhebhe murefu.
Ruoko rwakabata rosari imwechete. Ineruvara rwesirivha irikuvaima, uye yakagadzirwa nesimbi.

Panoiita sepachivanze pemusha, pane mbudzi hono mbiri  dziri kufamba.  Mbudzi idzi dzine ruvara ruchena uyezve dzakasimba. Nechekure kwembudzi idzi kune dzimwe mbudzi ina dzakarara panoiita sepamberi pemba.
Bhiriji rakawakwa ne masimbi akawanda uye rakareba kwarinoperera kune huswa hwegreen nerimwe sora rakaoma miti yakareba uye ine mashizha mudenga mune makore mashoma ari machena

Mdziyo inoshandiswa mumba yakarongedzwa kuti itengeswe.Inosanganisira inosanganisira inoshandiswa kuchekesa miriwo nemichero kuti iyite midiki iyo ine ruvara rwebhuruu.Koitawo ndiro dziri kumativi dzine ruvara rwesirivheri.
Maturo ebasa akagadzikwa pasi pane ruvara rutema. Maturo aya ane mibato yeruvara rwebhurauni yakagadzigwa nemapuranga. Nechekumberi yakavenzengwa ine ruvara rwesirivha ruri kuvaimira.

Pane migwagwa miviri inosanganisira mugwagwa wevanhu uyezve mugwagwa wemotokari. Mugwagwa wevanhu, pane munhu arikufamba ari oga mumugwagwa umu. Kozotowo mumugwagwa unofamba motokari kune motokari mbiri dziri kupesana.

Mumugwagwa une tara murikufamba motokari dzakasiyana dzinosanganisira mota diki, magonyeti nebhazi. Mujinga memugwagwa mune dzimwe motokari yakamira mubvute inoratidza kuti ino iri kumirira kutakura vanhu.

Nzvimbo ine matombo mazhinji anoratidza kuti akapfumba. Pamusoro pemamwe  tirikuona pakavata mbudzi dzinoratidza kuti dzine hukama sezvo dzine ruwara rwakafanana uye dzakazemberana zvadzo dzichiratidzana kuwirírana kukuru.
Mudzimai akasunga dhuku mumusoro uyewo akabata nhare mbozha arikuteerera. Akabatawo muchiuno.
Motikari yerudzi rwekombi, ine ruvara rwesirivha, ine mavhiri matema. Yakamira parutivi pemugwagwa pane masimbi matema.
Zvibeke  zvakasiyana zvakatsvetwa pamusoro petafura zvinoratidza kuti zvitsva nemhete nezvuma zvakagadzirwa nenzira dzakasiyana.  Zvunhu zvose izvi zvinoratidza kuti zvitsva uye zviri kutengeswa.
Mupopo murefu uri pamba pakakomberedzwa nerusvingo paine denga remba ririkubudikira.

Bhasikiti tsvuku rinoisirwa hembe dzakachena kana kuti dzakasviba. Bhasikiti iri rakagadzikwa pamusoro pemucheka uneruvara rwebhuruu neruchena. Mubhasikiti umu munehembe dzakazara uyezve rinemuvharo mutsvuku.

Chitofu chinowanikwa mumba mokubikira chinoshandisa gasi kuti chishande. Chakanaka zvikuru uye chinoratidza kuti chichiri chinyowani. Pekubikira pacho pane ruvara rwesiriveri uye pakati pacho pane goridhe . Chinoratidza kuti chinogara mapoto maviri. Muviri wayo une ruvara rutsvuku uye kumwe kwakatenderedzwa nezvitema. Chine pamwe pane chiruva chine mavara eyero.
Chikiti chine ruvara rwerupfupfu nemizera michena chine maziso ane ruvara rwerupfupfu nzeve dzaro ichena.
Badza rakagadzirwa nesimbi uyezve rashakara, rine mupinyi webango.  Badza iri rakagadzikwa pasi  pamahuswa ane ruvara rwegirinhi uyezve richinoita kakuchenerukira.
Chirimwa chemhiripiri chakairwa ivhu musaga chinemashizha asvibirira uyewo  chabereka,panemhiripiri imwechete iya isinganyanyovava yerudzi rwe girini.
Zvingoro zvakapakwa panzvimbo inevhu dzvuku.  Zvingoro izvi zvakagadzirwa nesimbi uye zvine ruvara rutema. Kumberi kwazvo Kune huni dzakatemwa dziripo.   Kumativi kune vanhu vari kufamba.
Zvinhu zvekutengesa zvinosanganisira nzungu, madomasi,  dovi, uyewo pane zvitinha zvakaturikidzaniswa. Vanhu vakagara nemumwe ari kurudyi  akagara akabata masaga maviri jena nere girini.

Datya rine mavara mavara. Rineruvara rweginhi robva raita mavara machena. Rinemapundu mapundu aneruvara rwuchena. Maziso aro, rinoratidza kuti rinemaziso matsvuku. Datya rinowadzowanikwa nguva yekunaya kwemvura.
Motokari imwe chete doko ichena yakamira pedyo nemudhuri une fafitera rakavhurwa.  Pasi pane sora shoma regirini uye netumatombo tudoko twakasangana nemavhu tuchena.
Pakati perimwe dhorobha pane vanhu vari kufamba. Vanhu ava vari kupfuura pamberi pemisika. Mumwe wemusika waka waridzwa shangu pasi. Kozoti umwe wemusika wacho wakawaridzwa mabhuku.
Motokari  dziri kufamba mumugwagwa wetara. Nechekurudyi kune mumwe mugwagwa wemavhu wakazarawo marara une mitiwo nechekudivi kwavo. Pakati pawo pane miti mihombe nemidiki.
Dzimba, matanda emagetsi tambo dzemagetsi, tiranzifoma uswa hwakaoma miti dzine mashizha akasvibira uye mamwe akaoma.

Nzvimbo inehuswa hwakasvibira uye ine miti yakawanda. Panoonekwawo nzira inofamba ichipinda nemukati memuti. Kumberi kwemiti kunoonekwa jurahoo ririko. Uyewo mukati mejurahoo munoonekwa kuti muneimba ine mataiwo matsvuku.
Pakati pekuguta pane dzimba dzemunhurikidzwa nemotikari dzakawanda dzakamira navanhu.
Paruvanze pane maruva nezvekutambisa zvevana nebhutsu.
Munhukadzi arikuteka mvura pamugodhi. Mudhuri wakavakwa nezvidhinha uye une marata. Mugwagwa unofamba motokari.
Vakomana vaviri vanoita zvemutambo wekurwa. Mutambo uyu unoshandiswa maoko namakumbo. Vakapfeka nhumbi dzakafanana. Nhumbi idzi dzine ruvara ruchena  dzobva dzaita mabhande muchiuno.
Pane sango rine miti yakawanda. Sango iri rine miti mipfupi nemirefu. Musango umu zvakare mune huswa hwakawanda. Kwozotiwo mudenga mune makore arikuratidza sekuchanaya.

Kabhasikoro kenhema nhema kemuimba yekugwinyisa muviri. Kanochovhewawo zvenhema kasina kwakari kuenda kuti ari kushanda nako agwinye muviviri. Karipo zvako hakasati kave neari kushandisa kakatongodzima zvako. Kanoratidza kuti kanozoshanda namagetsi kana ochovha munhu.

Mudzimai arimumvura akabata hari yaari kudira mvura yaachera murwizi.  Mudzimai uyu akarukwa wigi yaka reba ineruvara rutema.  Akapfeka zvishongo zvechinyakare uye zvirikuratidza kuti arikuita zvemashave.
Munda wakarimwa makabhechi ayo anoratidza kuti asvika panguva yekunge achikwanisa kudyiwa navanhu. Anobatsirawo vanhu kuti vange vachidya pamwe chete nekuwana mari kana achinge atengeswa.
Mukati medhorobheni mune zvitoro zvakarunda mugwagwa. Chimwe chezvitoro ichi ndechinotengeswa mushonga chiri padivi pacho ndechinotengeswa mbatya.

Vatambi vemutambo wenhabvu varikuseshena. Vakapfeka zvikadabura zveyero nehembe dzegirinhi kumusoro nemasokisi matsvuku nebhutsu dzakasiyana-siyana makara. Varikumhanyira munhandare munesora regirinhi.
Muriwo we(cabbage) wakawanda une mashizha mahome uye nevana vakakura. Pamusoro pane tambo dzemagetsi uye pane muti uri parutivi wakakura uye usina mashizha.
Mureza wekunyika yeSouth Vietnam uyo uneruvara rwenhundurwa rwakautenderedza. Nechepakati pawo pane maraini arikubva kurudyi achienda kuruboshwe ayo aneruvara rutsvuku.
Munhu akapfeka nguwo dzine ruvara rutema kumusoro uye dzine maoko madiki nemutodo une ruvara rwakacheneruka nechekumusoro nekusvibira nechekuzasi.
Chikafu chakabikwa zvamandiriri chiri mundiro chena. Pane nyama yanatsokugochwa zvakanaka. Mavhoko akachekererwa zvakanaka, hanyanisi, tomatisi, mapoteto, gaka netumupungawo pakona pendiro iyi.

Musikana mushava tsvarakadenga. Nyangwe tisinakuona kumeso kwake asi unongoona kuti musikana akanaka akageza akashambidzika zvakanaka. Anevhudzi rake rakasvibira zvakanaka. Akashongedza musoro wake zvakanaka. Anemhete nechishongedzo chemusoro zvakafanana. Musikana uyu akapenda nzwara dzake dzemuruoko nependi yebhuruu.
Matengi emvura akagadzikwa pamatombo.Parutivi pacho pane miti.
Vanhu varikufamba vari vechidzimai, vachidarika nepasi pemiti ine mahunde akakura uye ine mabukira epingi. Vakatarisa dzimba dzakavakwa dzine matayera matsvuku

Vakadzi vakapfeka mbatya dzakafanana vakaita zvitaera zvakasiyana kuti mufananidzo wavo ubude zvavanoda. Vese vakapfeka mbatya nhema dzine tumabhotai tuchena uyewo vari pamberi  vese vakagwadama. Vari kumasure vakaisa maoko muhombodo.
Imba isirikunyatsooneka. Irikungooneka kumberi kwayo nekudivi. Hatisi kuona zviripamusoro. Yakavakwa pakaunganidzwa mavhu., uye pane zvakaita kunge zvidhina zviripo. Kumberi kune zvimwe zvivako.
Vakomana vezvingoro vari kufamba  mukati meguta. Umwe wacho akapfeka hembe chena nemutirauzi mutema. Akasungira chibhegi muhuro.
Chivakwa chemapuranga. Parutivi pane maruva akadyarwa mumagaba. Maruva aya ane mashizha akasvibira.
Chivakwa chine ruvara rutsvuku parutivi pane muti wakakura usina mashizha, uye gedhe rakagadzirwa nesimbi rakazara ngura.

Vanhurume vanotamba mitambo webhora varikuonekwa vakabata zvipfuva zvavo veri mumutsetse nechekumhiri kuri kuonekwa zvituro zvine ruvara rutsvuku nezvine ruvara rweyero nerwe girini kune vanhu vakamira ikoko umwechete akagara pasi.

Mudzimai ari kufamba. Wakabata bhegi rine ruvara ruchena. Kumusoro akapfeka hembe ine ruvara rwakachenerukira kuzasi kune hembe ine ruvara rwepingi. Mudzimai uyu muruoko akabata nharembozha ine ruvara rutema.
Munhurume mumwe chete anofamba. Akapfeka hembe yepepuro kumusoro nebhurukwa zasi. Akabereka bhegi ritema. Mumusoro akapfeka ngowani. Parutivi pake pane chidziro cheyero.
Pane wadhiropu yakagadzirwa nemapuranga iripo. Wadhiropu iyi ine magonhi akawanda. Uyezve wadhiropu iyi ine fafitera riripo kozoti makabati ekuvhura
Muti wemupopo mumwe chete une mashizha egirini neamwe eyero. Pamusoro pemuti pane tambo ina dzemagetsi.

Dutavanhu ririkuratidza kuti riri kuenda kuHarare. Riri kufambawo mutara. Dutavanhu iri pasi paro patsvuku nemafafitera matema. Pane vanhuwo varikufamba mumugwagwa, mudivi memugwagwa uyu murikufamba dutavanhu vachienda kunzvimbo dzakasiyana-siyana.
Mudhorobha mune vanhu vanofamba. Parutivi pavo pane chitoro chihombe chinotengesa midziyo yakasiyana siyana yemumba. Parutivi pane motokari yakamira.

Motokari  yerwudzi rweHonda fiti  dziya dzinoshandiswa nevazhinji mumadhorobha kutakura vanhu  dzichiita zvemushika- shika.  Iri kuratidza kuti  iri kubuda mumugwagwa unetara  ichiienda parutivi pana mai vari kufambisa  vachiratidza kuti  vari kunanga kumota iyi vari kuratidza kuti vari kuda kukwira vagofamba nayo.

Nzvimbo yakapfuma inoratidza kuti inofambwa nevanhu vazhinjj. Nzvimbo iyi inemiti mikuru yakakombodza yemijakaranda ine maruva epepo, pasi pacho pakazara maruva emuti uyu. Nechekumberi tirikuona zvivakwa zvakapendiwa zvakanaka ikapendwa nependi tsvuku muzasi nekirimu kumusoro.

Mukoma  arikufamba akabata imbwa mbiri aina vamwe vakoma  vaviri kumativi kwake. Mukoma uyu akapfeka chikabudura chine ruvara rutema neshangu dema. Imbwa dzake dzine muviri une ruvara rutema  neruvara rwebhurauni.

Muchina unoshanda namafuta emotokari kugadzira magetsi. Muchina uyu unoratidza kuti une ruvara rwebhuruu. Wakanyorwa parutivi namavara machena. Muchina uyu kazhinji unowanzoshandiswa kana magetsi asiko kana kuti kunzvimbo dzisingaite magetsi.

Chigaro chechivezwa chakagadzirwa chakacherwa kunozendama munhu uye chakasiiwa makwati ari mumativi macho. kumashure kwacho chakavezwa chakakovhorwa nechemukati uyewo kumberi chakamenywa chikasiiwa makwati mumativi.

Shangu dzine ruvara rwebhuruu uye ruvara rwutsvuku mukati. Dzakaiswa tambo pamusoro ine ruvara rwebhuruu dzinobetsera kusunga shangu dzacho kuti dzisadonhe kana munhu akapfeka uye dzinowanzo pfekwa nevanhu mumitambo yakadai sokumhanya kana kutamba bhora.

Zvisimwa zvakachekererwa zvakanaka. Zvineruvara rwegirinhi. Murutivi mune mudhuri wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvitema uye mberi kune sora regirinhi nemiti yakareba. Nechekurudyi kune mota yesirivha irikuoneka kumashure.

Vatambi vaviri vakamira pamwe chete vese varikuratidza kufara nekunyemwerera.Vakapfeka yunifomu dzavo dzine mavara ebhuru uye dzinevo tumavara tuchena pamberi nechekumashure kune zvivakwa nemiti zviriko.

Varume vana  varipanzvimbo inoratidza kuti i  growth point. Vamwe vaviri  vavo vakamira pachingoro varikuita sevari kuburutsa zvunhu muchingoro. Chimwe chingoro chakatsvetwa pazasi  pe bhakani rekushambadzira zvinhu. Mumwe murume akamira  nechekumberi akapeta maoko achiratidza kuti ari mundangariro ane zvaari kufunga .

Muguta reHarare mugwagwa. Kwabva kunaya. Mukoma ari kukungurutsa chingoro chine mabhanana neeperu akapfeka heti yeredhi. Mune motokari dzakawanda dziri kufamba mumugwagwa umu. Mativi emugwagwa anedzimba dzemuturikidzanwa. Nechemberi kuchiumbwa chambuya Nehanda.
Bhatafurayi inova mhuka inobva kugonye.Ina makwamba ane ruvara rwebundo uye ruvara ruchena.Yakavhura mapapiro ayo kuratidza kuti inoda kubhururuka.
Vanhu vakagara pamabwe vamwe vakagara paruvare. Zvidhororo zviri kumashure kwevanhu. Huswa hwakawoma, munhukadzi akapfeka ngowani ine ruvara.

Chikabati chakashongedzwa nemicheka. Pane webhuruwu nomuchena, kozouya weyero. Muchena ndiwo wakachivhara wakachikomberedza, webhuruwu ukazogadzirwa pamusoro, wakachishongedza nenzira dzakasiyana, wakasiya mucheka muchena mukuru uchionekwa.

Chigubhu chemafuta ekubikira. Chineruvara rweyero. Muvharo uneruvara rutsvuku. Nechepahati parutivi rwechigubhu panoratidza kuti pane bepa. Bepa iri rakanyorwa nemavara matsvuku kuti JADU. Rakanyorwa avakare nemavara machena akasangana nematsvuku kuti Premium Cooking Oil.

Nzvimbo inezvivakwa zvakawanda. Zvimwe zvakavakwa nezvitina zvitema poitawo imwe imba yakavakwa nezvitina zvitsvuku irikubudikira. Panoratidza kuti pachikoro. Pane munhurume wechikuru akababereka bhegi ramabhuku arikuenda pazvivakwa izvi.
Mapini anoshandiswa kunamira zvinyorwa pamadziro, chinyoreso chekunyoresa mubhuku, chekunamisa kana uchikavha mabhuku chekuchekesa.
Mupunga wakadyarwa panzvimbo yemachakwi uye yakavorera. Zvinoratidza kuti mupunga uyu uri kukura zvakanaka asi hausati zvawo wabereka. Mune mamwe mapundo mashomanana asiri emupunga.
Mune mumwe mugwagwa urikuita seuri kupfura bhazi riri kuratidzira mumvuri waro.  Pane zambuko riripo. Nechekure kwe zambuko iri kuri kuratidza kuti kune miti iriko.
Masora akaungana zvakanaka panzvimbo yaari.  Pane mamwe akatumbuka zvichena. Kouyawo mamwe ari kudonha achinanga pasi. Mamwewo akatarisa mudenga. Uyewo pakadai panowanikwa tupuka tudiki.

Vanhu vari kufamba mumugwagwa vakatakura zvinhu. Pane mukadzi akabereka mwana ane jira rine ruvara rutsvuku noruchena uyewo mumaoko ake akabata zvinhu zvinokwana kuita zvitatu, chipepa chemachipisi, poita pepabhegi rine zvimaputi, kwoita imwewo zvakare bepa rakavharwa risiri kuonekwa zvirimo.
Muneimwe ndiro chena, makapakurirwa sadza jena uyezve matumbu nemakuru emombe.Zvakapakurwa izvi zvinoyevedza.
Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara. Kumativi kwemugwagwa uyu kune miti mizhinji isina mashizha akawanda. Imwe yemiti iyi Ina maruva ane ruvara rwe purple.

Chikasha chehozhwa chiri pasi chiri pauriri rune ruvara rwebhurauni. Uye hazvizivikanwi kuti mune hozhwa here kana kuti yakafa kare. Chiri pedyo nepamwe pakasvibira. Uyewo hozhwa dzinoziikanwa nekupa vanhu chirwere chekuti kana vachirasa mvura inge ine ropa.
Pamberi pemusha unoratidzika sewe  mudhorobha pane heji nemiti yakachekererwa zvakanaka. Pasi pemiti iyi pane huswa hwakasvibira. Nechemukati me juraho remusha uyu mune miti mirefu.
Zvigaro zvitema zvinenge zvakagadzirwa ne"plastic" zvakadurikidzana.
Pane mugwagwa urikufamba motokari kusanganisira rimwe bhazi rakatevedzana nekamwe kamota kachena. Nechekurutivi kwemugwagwa uyu kune dzimwe motokari dzakamira ikoko.
Jurahoro remapanera.  Mapouro emagetsi akatokonekitwa tambo dzacho dzemagetsi.  Dzimba dzokugara dzakawanda.  Matanda akadzimikwa muvhu.

Imba huru yakavakwa zvakanaka inoratidza kuti yava nenguva  yavakwa  , yaka purasitiwa así haina kuzopendwa. Paruwazhe rwayo pakasakurwa , hapana kana bundo. Nechekunze kunoratidza kuti pane hembe dzakayanikwa pamatanda.
Nzvimbo yesango ine miti yemisango, hapana michero uye bondo refu rinotaridza kuti hapana vanofambako asi mhuka, uye vanhu vangatoshandisa mugwagwa kana vaine motokari, vachiona vaine motokari.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuva sango . Mune miti mizhinji isina mashizha. Knne umwewo une mashizha akasvibira. Nzvimbo iyi ine sora rakaoma neivhu rakasvibira.

Mugwagwa une tara. Padivi pomugwagwa uyu pane nzvimbo yakakomboredzwa ine matombo akavezwa anoratidza kuti matombo aya ndeaya anowadzokuiswa pamakuva. Nechekumberi kwematombo aya kurikubudikira motokari hombe inozikanwa nokunzi magonyeti.

Nzvimbo ine miti yakasiyana siyana, miti iyi ina mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini, koita zvakare makirasirumhu anoratidza kuti akavakwa akapendwa neruvara rweyero. Pamusoro padenga pane ruvara rwakachenerukira
Dzimba dzakawanda dzemurokesheni padivi padzo pane musika muduku une zvokudya zviri mumapepa, musika wakagadzirwa namapango uye une bepa repurasitiki ritema pamusoro.
Bundo rakaoma. Vanhu vari kufamba munzira. Miti ine maruva ane ruvara rwepepo. Mugwagwa une motokari dziri kufamba.
Zvinodyiwa zvakatsvetwa patende zvinonosanganisira ndiro inomupunga nenyama uyewo doro rinodaidzwa kunzi supa maPeps nemabanana.

Mugwagwa une tara. Nechemujinga memugwagwa uyu mune motokari dzinonyanya kushandiswa nevazhinji mumadhorobha vachifamba kubva kumarokesheni vachipinda pakati pedhorobha dzinozivikanwa nokunzi makombi. Nechemujinga macho kumberi kuri kubudikira mudhuri une chikwangwani chinoratidza kuti munotengeswa nyama kwatingati mubhucha.

Chitoro chikuru chakashongedza zvipfeko zvemumuviri zvejuwerari.Zvimwe zviri pazvidhori zvichena zvimwe zvidhori zvitema.Zvimwe zvidhori zviri pasi.Imwe juwerari kana kuti mamwe manekiresi akaita zvekuturikwa mudenga. Zvimwe zvakaiswa mugirazi kuti vanhu vaone.Zvese zviri kushongedzwa kuti vanhu vanhu vatenge.Zvine ruvara rwegoridhe,zvimwe zvesirivha nezvimwe zvakawanda.
Munhurume akapfeka hembe yebhuruu, akamira kuseri kwemaruva.

Rokwe refu rebhuruu rine maoko marefu. Rakashongedzwa pachipfuva nechekuruboshwe nemavara machena. Rakapfekwa nemukadzi akamira panzvimbo yegirini ari pakati pemasimbi maviri ane ruvara rweorenji. Nechekumashure kwake kune munhurume  akapfeka sikipa yegirini.
Chishongedzo chinopfekewa nevanhu vechikadzi chinozivikanwa chichinzi nekiresi chinopfekwa pahuro.Chakaiswa mukati mepurasitiki chakagadzikwa pamusoro petafura.

Imbwa yakarara mujinga memugwagwa. Pane chitebhuru chiripo chinoratidza kuti vanhu vano pota vachitengesa panzvimbo iyoyo. Mugwagwa une tara unoratidza kufamba nemotikari. Ruvara rweimbwa ine bhurauni nekucheneruka zvakare.

Mbatya dzinopfekwa nevanhu dzakaunganidzwa pasi kuti vanhu vatenge. Pane munhukadzi akamira pakati padzimwe mbatya. Dzineruvara rwegirinhi dzimwe itsvuku, uyewo dzimwe ichena. Nechekurutivi pane shangu dzakaiswa pakati kwirirei zvishoma.

Mugwagwa unetara unemotokari irikufamba inowadzokushandiswa nevazhinji kutakura vanhu mumadhorobha wachiita zvemushikashika. Nechomujinga memugwagwa uyu mune muti mukuru inoratidza kuti mijakaranda. Kumberi tikuona mudhuri wakakomberedza nzvimbo ine miti yakawanda inosanganisira mijakaranda nemi paini.
Ruva rakamira panzvimbo yakanaka rakamira nechepamucheto pemba uyewo rine ruva rimwe chete dzvuku mashizha aro akada kuita seemubhanana rine mamwe mashizha ari kuoma.
Chimiro chepakati peguta. Pane zvivakwa zvemudurikidzanwa nezvitoro zvinotengesa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana. Vanhu vanoonekwa vachifamba vachitenga vamwe vachitengesawo zvese varume nevanhukadzi.

Dzimba dzakakomberedzwa nezvinhu zvinoyevedza zvakawanda. Idzo dzimba dzakareba uye dzakakomberedzwa nemasora akasvibira zvikuru. Poitao miti yakati chechetere yakaenzana uyeo nzvimbo yacho yakanaka kutarisa.
Zvuma zvakagadzirwa nemhando dzakasiyana uye dzine mavara akasiya zvakaungaunidzwa zvakaita zviputu zvichiendererana nemagadzirirwo, uye nemavara azvo, uye  zviri kuratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa.

Mugwagwa wakapamhamha  une tara unofamba motikari dzakasiyana dziri kuratidza kuti dziri kupesana.   Mujinga memigwagwa umu mune miti mikuru inosanganisira miJacaranda.   Pasi pemiti iyi pane sora rakaoma rinoratidza kuti rava nenguva risina kumbonaiwa nemvura.  Kune rumwe ritivi kuri kuratidza nzira inofamba veruzhinji vaya vanofamba netsoka.

Chitima chirikufamba munjanji , chitima ichi cheneruvara rwegirinhi nechokumberi chobva chaita ruvara rwutsvuku. Ichi chitima ichi chinoratidza kuva chemhandi yakudhara, uye chinogova kuva chinoshanda namarasha.
